measurement_index.description: Frame Protocol in WBTS measurement (M5003)

measurement_index.name: Signaling Load in WBTS
measurement_index.description: Signaling Load in WBTS measurement (M5004) provides information about the amount of radio link setups per second, queuing time and rejections due to congestion.

measurement_index.name: HSPA in WBTS Extension
measurement_index.description: HSPA in WBTS Extension measurement (M5005) measures HSPA in WCDMA Base Station.

measurement_index.name: WBTS R99 HW Resource
measurement_index.description: WBTS Release 99 HW Resource (M5006) measures Release 99 HW Resources in WCDMA Base Station

measurement_index.name: WBTS level monitoring
measurement_index.description: WBTS level monitoring (M5008) provides information about various telecom counters (like BTS throughput, license utilization, CE or HW utilization) aggregated on BTS level.

measurement_index.name: Operator specific statistics
measurement_index.description: Operator specific statistics (M5009) provides information to differentiate operator measurement data in cell level.

measurement_index.name: HSPA Scheduler Monitoring
measurement_index.description:
HSPA Scheduler Monitoring (M5011) provides information
about various telecom counters aggregated on HSDPA/HSUPA scheduler level.

measurement_index.name: WCDMA SI Monitoring
measurement_index.description: WCDMA SI Monitoring Measurement (M5014) provides information about SBTS Sales Items.

measurement_index.name: DL Power Monitoring
measurement_index.description: DL Power Monitoring (M5015) measures Downlink Power in WCDMA Cell

measurement_index.name: Cell Resource
measurement_index.description: Cell Resource measurement (M1000) measures cell resources and availability

measurement_index.name: Service Level
measurement_index.description: Service Level measurement (M1001) measures RRC and RAB connections. Both RRC and RAB connection are divided into three phases: setup, access, and active phase. This measurement provides information on incoming handovers and SRNC relocations, RAB holding times, DCH holding times per NRT RAB type, RRC and RAB setup times, and multi-RABs

measurement_index.name: Traffic
measurement_index.description: Traffic measurement (M1002) provides information on DCH requests and allocations, and on compressed mode requests and allocations.

measurement_index.name: L3 signalling at Iu
measurement_index.description: L3 signalling at Iu measurement (M1003) measures Iu-interface signalling.

measurement_index.name: L3 signalling at Iur
measurement_index.description: L3 signalling at Iur measurement (M1004) measures Iur-interface signalling.  This measurement was enhanced in RN4.0 to support both RNC & IADA object types as Handover Target.

measurement_index.name: L3 signalling at Iub
measurement_index.description: L3 signalling at Iub measurement (M1005) measures Iub-interface signalling.

measurement_index.name: RRC signalling
measurement_index.description: RRC Signalling measurement (M1006) measures RRC signalling by recording signalling events on the RRC layer.

measurement_index.name: Soft Handover
measurement_index.description: Soft Handover measurement (M1007) measures soft handovers by collecting statistics of the performance of the soft and softer handover procedures and the CPICH Ec/No values.

measurement_index.name: Intra System Hard Handover
measurement_index.description: Intra System Hard Handover measurement (M1008) measures intra system hard handovers and HS-DSCH/E-DCH serving cell changes.

measurement_index.name: L3 Relocation signalling
measurement_index.description: L3 Relocation Signalling measurement (M1009) measures signalling of outgoing ISHO, HHO and SRNC relocation. It includes Iur signalling between source and target RNCs, Iu signalling between source RNC and CN, and Iu signalling between CN and target RNC. This measurement was enhanced in RN4.0 to support both RNC & IADA object types as Handover Target.

measurement_index.name: Inter System Hard Handover
measurement_index.description: Inter System Hard Handover measurement (M1010) measures outgoing inter system hard handovers from WCDMA to GSM.

measurement_index.name: Location Services
measurement_index.description: Location Services measurement (M1011) measures location services by providing information on location specific RANAP signalling, and on the success of location calculation.

measurement_index.name: Service Area Broadcast
measurement_index.description: Service Area Broadcast measurement (M1012) measures Iu-BC interface signalling. It provides information on sent and received Service Area Broadcast Protocol (SABP) messages.

measurement_index.name: Autodef SHO
measurement_index.description: Autodef Soft Handover measurement (M1013) measures soft handover success rate for cell pairs. This measurement was enhanced in RN4.0 to support both RNC & IADA object types as Handover Source and Target.

measurement_index.name: AutoDef IFHO
measurement_index.description: AutoDef Inter Frequency HHO measurement (M1014) measures intra system hard handover success rate for cell pairs. This measurement was enhanced in RN4.0 to support both RNC & IADA object types as Handover Source and Target.

measurement_index.name: AutoDef ISHO
measurement_index.description: AutoDef Inter System Handover measurement (M1015) measures inter system hard handover success rate for cell pairs. This measurement was enhanced in RN4.0 to support both RNC & IADA object types as Handover Source.

measurement_index.name: RCPM OLPC
measurement_index.description: RCPM OLPC measurement (M1016) measures outer loop power control. It provides information on uplink radio connection quality and on downlink radio link power. It is based on information available for the OLPC and NBAP entities of the RNC.

measurement_index.name: RCPM RLC
measurement_index.description: RCPM RLC measurement (M1017) measures AM-RLC connection performance. It provides information on downlink radio connection quality. It is based on information available for the acknowledged mode RLC entity of the RNC.

measurement_index.name: RCPM UEQ
measurement_index.description: RCPM UEQ measurement (M1018) measures UM-RLC and Transparent-RLC downlink performance. It provides information on the quality of the downlink radio connections using RLC Unacknowledged or Transparent Mode. It is based on UE quality measurements.

measurement_index.name: AutoDef LTE
measurement_index.description: AutoDef LTE measurement (M1019) measures inter system hard handover success rate from 3G to LTE per source and target cell pair.

measurement_index.name: Iu-PC Interface
measurement_index.description: Iu-PC Interface measurement (M1021) measures Iu-PC interface towards Standalone SMLC.

measurement_index.name: Packet Call
measurement_index.description: Packet Call measurement (M1022) measures the packet call statistics from the mobile and end user's perspective.

measurement_index.name: Cell Throughput
measurement_index.description: Cell Throughput measurement (M1023) allows network wide monitoring of the radio resource throughput per cell by collecting measurement data from MAC-d layer in RNC. This enables customers to monitor the average cell throughput of MAC-d layer for HS-DSCH, E-DCH and DCH traffic, separately per traffic type. In addition, it enables optimisation possibilities about the share of HSDPA vs. DCH capacity.

measurement_index.name: RCPM OLPC WCEL
measurement_index.description: RCPM OLPC WCEL measurement (M1024) measures outer loop power control performance and uplink radio connection quality. The RNC pre-aggregates the measurement results to WCEL level.

measurement_index.name: RCPM OLPC RNC
measurement_index.description: RCPM OLPC RNC measurement (M1025) measures outer loop power control performance and uplink radio connection quality. The RNC pre-aggregates the measurement results to RNC level.

measurement_index.name: RCPM RLC WCEL
measurement_index.description: RCPM RLC WCEL measurement (M1026) measures the quality and throughput of radio connections using Acknowledged Mode RLC. The RNC pre-aggregates the measurement results to WCEL level.

measurement_index.name: RCPM RLC RNC
measurement_index.description: RCPM RLC RNC measurement (M1027) measures the quality and throughput of radio connections using Acknowledged Mode RLC. The RNC pre-aggregates the measurement results to RNC level.

measurement_index.name: Autodef SHO DSR
measurement_index.description: Autodef SHO DSR (M1028) measurement measures the CPICH EcNo and CPICH RSCP reported by the UEs for detected set cells that the RNC cannot identify based on the neighbour cell definitions.

measurement_index.name: Device Detection
measurement_index.description: Device Detection measurement (M1029) measures IMEI queries and feature blacklist/whitelist actions performed by the RNC based on the UE model.

measurement_index.name: WBTS Resource
measurement_index.description: WBTS Resource measurement (M1031) measures the number of users in WBTS level.

measurement_index.name: CS Voice HSPA User Plane
measurement_index.description: CS Voice HSPA User Plane measurement (M1032) measures CS Voice over HSPA user plane quality.

measurement_index.name: CPICH Quality
measurement_index.description: Measurement M1033 CPICH Quality provides information about CPICH RSCP and EcNo in RRC Connection Request.

measurement_index.name: Operator Statistics in RNC
measurement_index.description: This measurement is a collection of basic statistics about accessibility, retainability, and resource usage reported based on the operator-ID when either the RAN2412 Inter Circle Roaming feature or RAN2825 MOCN Capacity Assurance feature is in use.

measurement_index.name: DSCP Statistics
measurement_index.description: This measurement provides information on the DSCP code marking of the Iu-PS user plane data received by the RNC.

measurement_index.name: LTE Relocation
measurement_index.description: LTE Relocation measurement (M1036) measures RANAP signalling of outgoing inter-system handover from 3G to LTE.

RAB connections per Iur.

measurement_index.description: LTE Inter System Handover to GSM per Neighbor Cell measurement (M8019) measures the inter RAT handover related procedures per neighbor cell relation. The counters are updated for the cell pair "source cell - target GSM cell". The target identifier "{location area code (LAC)} + {target cell ID (TCID)}" is derived from the call processing protocols. It is not equal to the managed object identifiers known only in network management system.

measurement_index.name: LTE Cell Availability

measurement_index.name: LTE Handover

measurement_index.name: LTE X2AP
measurement_index.description: LTE X2AP (M8022) provides measurements related to X2 Setup procedure. The counters are updated at the originating eNB site.

measurement_index.name: LTE UE and Service Differentiation
measurement_index.description: LTE UE and Service Differentiation (M8023) measures Operator specific UE and Service Differentiation items.

measurement_index.name: LTE Handover to eHRPD per eHRPD bandclass
measurement_index.description: The measurement LTE Handover to eHRPD per eHRPD bandclass (M8025) contains counters which measure the Inter System Handover to eHRPD per eHRPD bandclass. For each handover relationship between the LTE cell (source of the inter system handover) and the eHRPD bandclass (target of the inter system handover) a separate counter is provided.

measurement_index.name: LTE QoS
measurement_index.description:

kpi_index.name: TCH availability ratio power down TRX excluded
kpi_index.abbr: TCH avail ratio power down TRX excluded
kpi_index.description:
Traffic channel timeslot availability as the percentage of configured resources. Includes both circuit switched and packet switched TSLs.
Timeslots locked by power save features RG301936 Intelligent MCPA TRX Power Down or BSS20984 2G TRX Automatic Power Down are excluded in denominator AVE_TCH_TSL_LOCKED_POWER_DOWN, because timeslots locked by these features are not counted as available but are counted in the total timeslot unavailable counter (ave_non_avail_tch_timeslot).

The counters in this formula are sampled every 20 seconds. It is normal that during the shutdown or powerup of the TRXs due to the Power Save Features a discrepancy occurs between the total time slots unavailable and the ones locked by the feature originating a slight and sporadic decrease in the KPI (close to 100%, but not 100%).

If TRXs are locked and BTSs and BCFs are unlocked, the TCH TSLs appear as unavailable. Thus both the system and the user can affect this KPI.
The KPI has to be counted separately different TRX types (trx_type: 0 = normal area ,1 = extended area, 2 = super-extended area).

kpi_index.name: TCH availability ratio
kpi_index.abbr: TCH avail ratio
kpi_index.description:
Failures (downtime) of TRXs cause loss of TCH and affect this KPI.
Notes:
1. The KPI has to be counted separately for extended and normal area (trx_type: 0 =normal, 1 = extended).
2. If TRXs are locked and BTSs and BCFs are unlocked, the TCHs appear as unavailable.
This means that both the system and the user can affect this KPI and make it
less useful.

kpi_index.name: Data service availability ratio
kpi_index.abbr: Data service avail ratio
kpi_index.description:
Data service availability (DSA) gives the estimated percentage of on-air GPRS-capable
BTSs that are able to provide the GPRS service. Detects outages in the GPRS and
EGPRS services. Outages may be caused by a fault in hardware or software.

kpi_index.name: Downlink multislot soft blocking
kpi_index.abbr: DL multislot soft block
kpi_index.description: Indicates the ratio of unserved timeslots requests to all requests in downlink. However, the old formula cannot distinguish soft blocking of MSS which have higher multislot class than network can support.

kpi_index.name: SDCCH blocking on, before FCS
kpi_index.abbr: SDCCH block before FCS
kpi_index.description:
Gives the probability to access SDCCH considering the effect of FCS. Applicable for
area and BTS level.

kpi_index.name: TCH call blocking, DR compensated
kpi_index.abbr: TCH call blck DR compensa
kpi_index.description:
This KPI measures the traffic channel congestion.
Use:
This KPI counts the impact of lacking TCH resources on call setup after the SDCCH phase. Soft blocking increases the value. Directed retry is not real blocking for the end user and therefore it is excluded. Also, the A-interface circuit type mismatch caused requests are not visible to end user and are therefore excluded. Use: Applicable on
BTS level even the BTS is part of multi-BTS segment.

kpi_index.name: SDCCH access probability, before FCS
kpi_index.abbr: SDCCH acc prob before FCS
kpi_index.description:
This KPI measures SDCCH congestion.
Use:

and BTS level.

kpi_index.name: Inadequate EDAP resources in DL limited by EDAP size
kpi_index.abbr: Indqt EDAP res DL lmt EDAP sz
kpi_index.description:
Indicates the time per gigabytes when the available downlink EDAP resources are inadequate
because of the size of the EDAP. The formula may not give correct values if:
 the object aggregation level is smaller than the BSC level, and
 one or more BTSs in the area has more than one dynamic Abis pool connected.

EGENA: CM parameter.
Definition: Attribute enables or disables EGPRS on BTS level. All GPRS-enabled TRXs of the BTS have to be EDGE capable.The GPRS must be enabled in the segment in order to enable EGPRS in the BTS.
Parameter id = 5051

kpi_index.name: Downlink MCS selection limited by PCU
kpi_index.abbr: DL MCS selec limit PCU
kpi_index.description:
Indicates the time per gigabytes when the available downlink EDAP resources are inadequate
(for a scheduled downlink TBF in BTSs where EGPRS is enabled) because of
PCU capacity. The formula may not give correct values if:
 the object aggregation level is smaller than the BSC level, and
 one or more BTSs in the area has more than one dynamic Abis pool connected.

EGENA: CM parameter.
Definition: Attribute enables or disables EGPRS on BTS level. All GPRS-enabled TRXs of the BTS have to be EDGE capable.The GPRS must be enabled in the segment in order to enable EGPRS in the BTS.
Parameter id = 5051

kpi_index.abbr: TCH drop conv R re-estab cons
kpi_index.description:

Inter-BSC handovers are subtracted in the denominator because they trigger
conver_started. Compensation is 100% true only if the area has no inter-BSC HOs from
outside the area.

to X. X = 5 is normally used as a quality indicator. If X = 5 and this figure is 100%, then

frbc: hierarchy object (BSC/FRBC/NSVC)
commited_info_rate: CM parameter
Definition: With this parameter you define the committed information rate.

NOTE: MML RANGE:
ETSI: 16..1984 (kbit/s, steps of 16 kbit/s)
ANSI: 16..1536 (kbit/s, steps of 16 kbit/s)

kpi_index.name: PCU Gb DL load
kpi_index.abbr: PCU Gb DL load
kpi_index.description:
This KPI is used to monitor the PCU load in terms of received DL Gb over IP traffic vs. Gb processing capacity.
Note that this does not indicate the exact Gb link load as the actual bandwidth is not known.
For the PCU1 and the first release of PCU2 (PDU2-D/U cards) the processing capability in terms of Gb traffic is 2Mbits/s.
For PCU2-E and PCUM cards the capability is higher and KPI values over 100% are possible.

kpi_index.name: Total HO failure ratio, area level
kpi_index.abbr: Tot HO FR, areaL
kpi_index.description:
This KPI can be used for dimensioning clusters to provide need capacity for MS mobility.
HO failure in Nokia BSS can occur without the actual HO command.
(for example, there is reason for a HO, but the target cell is full.) This KPI includes both
the failed HOs where the HO command is sent and those where the HO command is not
sent to the MS. HO failures are not visible to end (MS) users.

kpi_index.name: HO failure ratio due to radio interface blocking
kpi_index.abbr: HO FR due radio If block
kpi_index.description:
This KPI can be used for the dimensioning of clusters to provide need capacity for MS
mobility. Handover failure in Nokia BSS can occur without the actual
HO command. (for example, there is a reason for a HO, but the target cell is full).
Use:
This KPI is used on the area level.

kpi_index.name: HO drop ratio
kpi_index.abbr: HO DR
kpi_index.description:
This KPI defines how big a share of the started handovers are dropped. It indicates the
quality of the handovers. HO drops are visible as dropped calls to end (MS) users.
This KPI does not work on BTS level if the BTS is part of the multisegment. A reason for
this is that an attempt counter triggers for a target BTS only if a HO is successful. In the
case of a handover failure, the attempt counter triggers only for the master BTS.

kpi_index.name: Volume weighted LLC throughput DL

control (LLC) bytes are more than 1560.

kpi_index.name: Volume weighted LLC throughput for GPRS
kpi_index.abbr: Vol weighted LLC thp GPRS
kpi_index.description:

kpi_index.name: SDCCH drop ratio without timer T3101 expiry
kpi_index.abbr: SDCCH DR wo timer T3101 exp
kpi_index.description:

timer T3101. It is used to analyse SDCCH drops and reasons in case of Call Setup,
SMS, and LU. Call Setup failure is mostly visible to end (MS) users.
Use:
This KPI is used to follow up the performance of SDCCH from a technical point of view.

kpi_index.name: Downlink multislot allocation blocking
kpi_index.abbr: DL mslot alloc block
kpi_index.description:
If the blocking is met regularly, there is need either to expand the territory (CS traffic low)
or TCH capacity (CS traffic high).
Note: If the statistics show that there is blocking but no upgrade requests yet, the reason
may be that the territory has been smaller than the default setting defines (CS use). The
PCU will not make an upgrade request. This is because the CS side will return the
default channels back to the PS territory as soon as the CS load allows that.

kpi_index.name: Average DL TBF per timeslot
kpi_index.abbr: Avg DL TBF per TSL
kpi_index.description: Indicates how many downlink TBFs there are, on average, per timeslot.

kpi_index.name: Uplink signaling TBFs usage ratio
kpi_index.abbr: UL signaling TBFs usg R
kpi_index.description: Indicates the percentage of signalling TBFs from the total of all UL TBFs.

kpi_index.name: Downlink flush per minute
kpi_index.abbr: DL Flush pr min
kpi_index.description:
Indicates the number of temporary block flows (TBFs) that are interrupted by cell reselections
per "TBF minute". Indicates the level of subscriber mobility.

kpi_index.name: Share of EDGE requests
kpi_index.abbr: Share of EDGE req
kpi_index.description:
Shows the ratio of timeslot requests where EDGE resources are required. Works also if
EDGE is not activated in the network.

kpi_index.name: (E)GPRS TBF establishment failure ratio
kpi_index.abbr: (E)GPRS TBF establish FR
kpi_index.description:
This KPI calculates ratio of failed UL and DL TBFs due to no response from MS to all
TBFs (UL and DL).

kpi_index.name: TBF success ratio, releases due flush, suspend or dtm removed.
kpi_index.abbr: TBF SR, some rel removed
kpi_index.description:
Also called TBF retainability. This KPI is used to measure the quality of the radio interface
for TBF sessions. The KPI measures purely the retainability of TBFs and is not
dependent on interfaces and NEs outside BSS.
Note: Not usable on BTS level when common BCCH is used because TBF can start in
one BTS of a segment and end in another.

kpi_index.name: DFR Traffic share
kpi_index.abbr: DFR Usage
kpi_index.description: Gives the ratio of traffic served in the DFR mode

kpi_index.name: DL GPRS traffic, area
kpi_index.abbr: DL GPRS traffic
kpi_index.description: Indicates the amount of resources (timeslots) the GPRS traffic (excluding EDGE traffic) consumes on average during the period. This information is useful, for example, in forecasting the need for capacity extension. 50 blocks /sec /tsl is used to estimate timeslots.

kpi_index.name: UL GPRS traffic, area

kpi_index.name: Downlink EGPRS erlangs, area
kpi_index.abbr: DL EGPRS traffic

kpi_index.name: Average SDCCH traffic, based in sampling

kpi_index.description:

all the BTSs and then sum this formula over all underlying BTSs.

kpi_index.name: Average effective ACK GPRS UL throughput per used TSL
kpi_index.abbr: Avg ef ACK GPRS UL thp us TSL
kpi_index.description:
Indicates the impact of radio link quality on net data rate per used timeslot considering
retransmissions and coding scheme selection. The lower the value the poorer the radio
link quality causing retransmissions and use of lower coding schemes.
The numerator does not contain the RLC header bytes neither the does the MAC header
because the aim is to count data volume from the users point of view as close as possible.
The denominator is built on the fact that one timeslot can carry 50 RLC blocks per
second.
Note: Formula assumes that all GRPS unack RLC traffic is using CS1. With PCU2,
GPRS unack RLC traffic can use CS1-4. If there is a significant amount of GRPS unack
RLC traffic with CS2, the formula will give too high values.

kpi_index.name: PS traffic
kpi_index.abbr: PS traffic
kpi_index.description: Detects the maximum amount of PS data traffic during the measurement period.

kpi_index.name: Share of PS erlangs to all erlangs
kpi_index.abbr: Share of PS erl all erl
kpi_index.description: Indicates the ratio of PS traffic in erlangs compared to all erlangs (PS + CS).

kpi_index.name: Uplink RLC payload
kpi_index.abbr: UL RLC payload
kpi_index.description: Indicates all combined GPRS and EDGE payload data in uplink.

kpi_index.name: Downlink RLC payload
kpi_index.abbr: DL RLC payload
kpi_index.description: Indicates all combined GPRS and EDGE payload data in downlink.

kpi_index.name: DHR Traffic share
kpi_index.abbr: DHR Usage
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates TCH use % of DHR TCH.

kpi_index.name: TCH traffic sum in time
kpi_index.abbr: TCH traffic sum in time
kpi_index.description: TCH traffic sum in time, based in trf_492 this KPI presents the sum in objects and in the time interval selected.

kpi_index.name: UL cumulative level ratio in class 5
kpi_index.abbr: UL cumul lev R in cl 5
kpi_index.description:
This KPI gives the cumulative percentage of call samples in classes 0 to X. X = 5 is
normally used as a quality indicator. If X = 5 and this figure is 100%, the MS users obviously have not perceived any quality problems.

kpi_index.name: TCH availability ratio power down TRX excluded
kpi_index.abbr: TCH avail ratio power down TRX excluded
kpi_index.description:
Traffic channel timeslot availability as the percentage of configured resources. Includes both circuit switched and packet switched TSLs.
Timeslots locked by power save features RG301936 Intelligent MCPA TRX Power Down or BSS20984 2G TRX Automatic Power Down are excluded in denominator AVE_TCH_TSL_LOCKED_POWER_DOWN, because timeslots locked by these features are not counted as available but are counted in the total timeslot unavailable counter (ave_non_avail_tch_timeslot).

The counters in this formula are sampled every 20 seconds. It is normal that during the shutdown or powerup of the TRXs due to the Power Save Features a discrepancy occurs between the total time slots unavailable and the ones locked by the feature originating a slight and sporadic decrease in the KPI (close to 100%, but not 100%).

If TRXs are locked and BTSs and BCFs are unlocked, the TCH TSLs appear as unavailable. Thus both the system and the user can affect this KPI.
The KPI has to be counted separately different TRX types (trx_type: 0 = normal area ,1 = extended area, 2 = super-extended area).

kpi_index.name: TCH availability ratio
kpi_index.abbr: TCH avail ratio
kpi_index.description:
Failures (downtime) of TRXs cause loss of TCH and affect this KPI.
Notes:
1. The KPI has to be counted separately for extended and normal area (trx_type: 0 =normal, 1 = extended).
2. If TRXs are locked and BTSs and BCFs are unlocked, the TCHs appear as unavailable.
This means that both the system and the user can affect this KPI and make it
less useful.

kpi_index.name: Data service availability ratio
kpi_index.abbr: Data service avail ratio
kpi_index.description:
Data service availability (DSA) gives the estimated percentage of on-air GPRS-capable
BTSs that are able to provide the GPRS service. Detects outages in the GPRS and
EGPRS services. Outages may be caused by a fault in hardware or software.

kpi_index.name: Downlink multislot soft blocking
kpi_index.abbr: DL multislot soft block
kpi_index.description: Indicates the ratio of unserved timeslots requests to all requests in downlink. However, the old formula cannot distinguish soft blocking of MSS which have higher multislot class than network can support.

kpi_index.name: SDCCH blocking on, before FCS
kpi_index.abbr: SDCCH block before FCS
kpi_index.description:
Gives the probability to access SDCCH considering the effect of FCS. Applicable for
area and BTS level.

kpi_index.name: TCH call blocking, DR compensated
kpi_index.abbr: TCH call blck DR compensa
kpi_index.description:
This KPI measures the traffic channel congestion.
Use:
This KPI counts the impact of lacking TCH resources on call setup after the SDCCH phase. Soft blocking increases the value. Directed retry is not real blocking for the end user and therefore it is excluded. Also, the A-interface circuit type mismatch caused requests are not visible to end user and are therefore excluded. Use: Applicable on
BTS level even the BTS is part of multi-BTS segment.

kpi_index.name: SDCCH access probability, before FCS
kpi_index.abbr: SDCCH acc prob before FCS
kpi_index.description:
This KPI measures SDCCH congestion.
Use:
Gives the probability to access SDCCH without the effect of FCS. Applicable for area
and BTS level.

kpi_index.name: TCH dropped conversation ratio without RE
kpi_index.abbr: TCH drop conv
kpi_index.description:
This KPI tells the ratio of calls dropped while A and B are talking, that is after conn_ack.
Inter-BSC handovers are subtracted in the denominator because they trigger
conver_started. Compensation is 100% true only if the area has no inter-BSC HOs from
outside the area.

kpi_index.name: TCH dropped conversation ratio, with RE
kpi_index.abbr: TCH drop conv R re-estab cons
kpi_index.description:
This KPI tells the ratio of calls dropped while A and B are talking, that is after conn_ack.
Inter-BSC handovers are subtracted in the denominator because they trigger
conver_started. Compensation is 100% true only if the area has no inter-BSC HOs from
outside the area.

kpi_index.name: TCH drop call ratio, after TCH assignment, without RE
kpi_index.abbr: TCH DR aft TCH ass wo RE
kpi_index.description: TCH drop call %, after TCH assignment, without considering re-establishments. Use: This formula considers TCH assigments including incoming TCH to TCH handovers.

kpi_index.name: DL cumulative level ratio in class 5
kpi_index.abbr: DL cumul lev R in cl 5
kpi_index.description:
This KPI gives a cumulative percentage of call samples (AMR, non-AMR) in classes 0
to X. X = 5 is normally used as a quality indicator. If X = 5 and this figure is 100%, then
the MS users obviously have not perceived any quality problems.

kpi_index.name: DTM CS traffic ratio
kpi_index.abbr: DTM CS traffic ratio
kpi_index.description:
DTM is an application software that allows simultaneous CS and PS use. This KPI
defines the ratio of DTM CS traffic (in Erlang) to all CS traffic.

kpi_index.name: DTM PS payload ratio
kpi_index.abbr: DTM PS payload ratio
kpi_index.description: Ratio of DTM PS payload (UL plus DL) to all PS payload.

kpi_index.name: PCU Gb DL load
kpi_index.abbr: PCU Gb DL load
kpi_index.description:
This KPI is used to monitor the PCU load in terms of received DL Gb over IP traffic vs. Gb processing capacity.
Note that this does not indicate the exact Gb link load as the actual bandwidth is not known.
For the PCU1 and the first release of PCU2 (PDU2-D/U cards) the processing capability in terms of Gb traffic is 2Mbits/s.
For PCU2-E and PCUM cards the capability is higher and KPI values over 100% are possible.

kpi_index.name: Total HO failure ratio, area level
kpi_index.abbr: Tot HO FR, areaL
kpi_index.description:
This KPI can be used for dimensioning clusters to provide need capacity for MS mobility.
HO failure in Nokia BSS can occur without the actual HO command.
(for example, there is reason for a HO, but the target cell is full.) This KPI includes both
the failed HOs where the HO command is sent and those where the HO command is not
sent to the MS. HO failures are not visible to end (MS) users.

kpi_index.name: HO failure ratio due to radio interface blocking
kpi_index.abbr: HO FR due radio If block
kpi_index.description:
This KPI can be used for the dimensioning of clusters to provide need capacity for MS
mobility. Handover failure in Nokia BSS can occur without the actual
HO command. (for example, there is a reason for a HO, but the target cell is full).
Use:
This KPI is used on the area level.

kpi_index.name: HO drop ratio
kpi_index.abbr: HO DR
kpi_index.description:
This KPI defines how big a share of the started handovers are dropped. It indicates the
quality of the handovers. HO drops are visible as dropped calls to end (MS) users.
This KPI does not work on BTS level if the BTS is part of the multisegment. A reason for
this is that an attempt counter triggers for a target BTS only if a HO is successful. In the
case of a handover failure, the attempt counter triggers only for the master BTS.

control (LLC) bytes per TBF are more than 1560.

Modification of the BTS site type is possible only between the 2nd generation and Talk-family site types and from the 2nd generation or Talk-family site types to UltraSite site and Talk-family or UltraSite site types to Flexi EDGE type. The modification from the UltraSite or Flexi EDGE back to the 2nd generation or Talk-family site types is not possible.
Modification between BTSplus and other site types is not possible.
Modification from UltraSite or Flexi EDGE site type to Flexi Multiradio BTS site type is possible but not vice versa.

Range:  0 (2nd Generation), 1 (Talk-family), 2 (PrimeSite), 3 (MetroSite), 4 (InSite), 5 (UltraSite), 6 (Flexi EDGE), 7 (BTSplus), 8 (Flexi Multiradio) 

IMREPS: CM parameter
Definition: With this parameter you specify the granularity in which the radio measurements have to be transmitted on the A-bis interface in case they are enabled (e.g 8 = 1/8).

NOTE: Parameter is valid only for BTSplus site type
 
Range: 1..254
Default value =8

kpi_index.name: Average effective ACK GPRS UL throughput per used TSL
kpi_index.abbr: Avg ef ACK GPRS UL thp us TSL
kpi_index.description:
Indicates the impact of radio link quality on net data rate per used timeslot considering
retransmissions and coding scheme selection. The lower the value the poorer the radio
link quality causing retransmissions and use of lower coding schemes.
The numerator does not contain the RLC header bytes neither the does the MAC header
because the aim is to count data volume from the users point of view as close as possible.
The denominator is built on the fact that one timeslot can carry 50 RLC blocks per
second.
Note: Formula assumes that all GRPS unack RLC traffic is using CS1. With PCU2,
GPRS unack RLC traffic can use CS1-4. If there is a significant amount of GRPS unack
RLC traffic with CS2, the formula will give too high values.

kpi_index.name: Active HS-DSCH end user throughput
kpi_index.abbr: Act HS-DSCH  end usr thp
kpi_index.description:
The average active HS-DSCH MAC-d throughput from end user perspective, calculated
as the HSDPA MAC-d throughput at BTS, divided by the active HS-DSCH time
multiplied by the active users.  

The active time refers to the scheduled TTIs, i.e. when sending data. 
The active users refers to the number of users with data in the allocated buffer. 
Allocated buffer means that the users are scheduled or waiting to be scheduled in a TTI.

The throughput is looked at from MAC-d layer, i.e. how much MAC-d level
data the HS-DSCH is able to successfully transfer to UEs using the scheduled
TTIs, so this considers also the MAC-hs efficiency.

kpi_index.name: Active HS-DSCH end user throughput
kpi_index.abbr: Act HS-DSCH  end usr thp
kpi_index.description:
The average active HS-DSCH MAC-d throughput from end user perspective, calculated
as the HSDPA MAC-d throughput at BTS, divided by the active HS-DSCH time
multiplied by the active users.  

The active time refers to the scheduled TTIs, i.e. when sending data. 
The active users refers to the number of users with data in the allocated buffer. 
Allocated buffer means that the users are scheduled or waiting to be scheduled in a TTI.

The throughput is looked at from MAC-d layer, i.e. how much MAC-d level
data the HS-DSCH is able to successfully transfer to UEs using the scheduled
TTIs, so this considers also the MAC-hs efficiency.

kpi_index.abbr: AAL2 guaranteed bitrate
kpi_index.description:
The used AAL2 connectivity in RNC196 is the sum of AAL2 path configured cell rates on Iub, Iur and Iu.
M550C0 (AAL2_PATH_GUAR_CELL_RATE) is the configured cell rate for the ATM VCC. For CBR type VC connections this is the AAL2 VCC Peak Cell rate (PCR). For UBR+ VCC in a bundle, this is the PCR of the bundle. For UBR+ VCC not in a bundle, this is the Minimum Desired Cell Rate (MDCR) of the VCC.

kpi_index.name: NPGE Ethernet  Port TX Utilization
kpi_index.abbr: NPGE Eth Port TX Util
kpi_index.description: This is the sum af received Ethernet data compared to the maximum, limited by the parameter RNC_ETHERNET_BW. The formula should be used separately for each Ethernet port on NPGE.

kpi_index.name: NPGE RX Utilization
kpi_index.abbr: NPGE RX Utilization
kpi_index.description: The formula calculates the sum of received datavolumes, measured from all Ethernet ports of NPGE, converts the measurements to Kbps, and compares against the maximum SFU port rate, 1650000 kbps. The measured interface data is converted to ATM/AAL level with a factor of 1,1.

kpi_index.name: NPGE TX Utilization
kpi_index.abbr: NPGE TX Utilization
kpi_index.description: The formula calculates the sum of transmitted datavolumes, measured from all Ethernet ports of NPGE, converts the measurements to Kbps, and compares against the maximum SFU port rate, 1650000 kbps. The measured interface data is converted to ATM/AAL level with a factor of 1,1.

kpi_index.name: Maximum HSDPA Processing Sets Utilization ratio per BTS
kpi_index.abbr: Max HSDPA PS util BTS
kpi_index.description:
The maximum HSDPA Processing Sets Utilization ratio.

Processing Set Utilization ratio is based on two conditions - throughput utilization and number of users. Sampling for both conditions is constantly done and at the end of the measurement period the highest condition percentage value is given.

kpi_index.name: Maximum HSUPA Processing Sets Utilization ratio per BTS
kpi_index.abbr: Max HSUPA PS util BTS
kpi_index.description:
The maximum HSUPA Processing Sets Utilization ratio calculated as percentage of the used PS from the Licensed PS, obtained by sampling with a predefined sampling period during measurement period. 
Processing Set Utilization ratio is based on three conditions: 1) throughput utilization, 2) number of users, and 3) HW utilization for HSUPA. For the purpose of this counter, in each sample period, all conditions are calculated. The one with bigger percentage value is used. 
Note: In case of Flexi Rel1 HW, this counter is not produced at all.

kpi_index.name: Average HSUPA Processing Sets Utilization ratio per BTS
kpi_index.abbr: Avg HSUPA PS util BTS
kpi_index.description:
The average HSUPA Processing Sets Utilization ratio.

Processing Set Utilization ratio is based on three conditions - throughput
, number of users and hardware utilization. Sampling for the three conditions is constantly done and at the end of each sampling period the highest over all conditions percentage value is given.

kpi_index.name: ATM VCC egress utilization rate - (76 - < 88) %
kpi_index.abbr: ATM VCC traf load DL cl 4
kpi_index.description:
Outgoing ATM layer traffic utilization rate (76% < X < 88 %) for single ATM VC connection. 
The load is measured in RNC egress direction. 
It depends on the selected configuration, which traffic type utilizes one VCC. 
The ATM VCC traffic throughput is compared to the VCC PCR (in the case of CBR connection) or MDCR (in the case of UBR+ connection) to calculate the load [%]. 
If there is dedicated VC connection used for HSDPA, this KPI can be used to follow the HSDPA load over Iub and the same applies to other traffic types as well.
