kpi_index.description: Average EIPU Pool Fill Factor during the reporting period. Fill factor is the ratio of current load to the available resources in the resource pool before critical load. Value 100% means that overload handling triggers.

kpi_index.name: Average Required Number of EIPU by CP CPU Load
kpi_index.abbr: Avg Req Num of EIPU CP CPU
kpi_index.description: Average required number of EIPUs due to CP CPU Load during the reporting period. The required number of EIPUs is equal to the number of fully utilised EIPUs without any safety margin.

kpi_index.name: Average Required Number of EIPU by UP CPU Load
kpi_index.abbr: Avg Req Num of EIPU UP CPU
kpi_index.description: Average required number of EIPUs due to UP CPU Load during the reporting period. The required number of EIPUs is equal to the number of fully utilised EIPUs without any safety margin.

kpi_index.name: Voice Call Setup Success Ratio (CSSR)
kpi_index.abbr: CSSR CS Voice
kpi_index.description: AMR Call Setup Success Ratio [%] over the reporting period.

kpi_index.name: UDI Call Setup Success Ratio (CSSR)
kpi_index.abbr: UDI CSSR
kpi_index.description: UDI Call Setup Success Ratio [%] over the reporting period.

kpi_index.name: Streaming Call Setup Success Ratio (CSSR)
kpi_index.abbr: Stream CSSR
kpi_index.description: Streaming Call Setup Success Ratio [%] over the reporting period.

kpi_index.name: Packet Service Setup Success Ratio (CSSR)
kpi_index.abbr: CSSR PS NRT
kpi_index.description: Packet Service Setup Success Ratio [%] over the reporting period.

kpi_index.name: AAL2 path average reserved bandwidth
kpi_index.abbr: Alloc avg cap of CBR VCC
kpi_index.description: The ratio between average reserved bandwidth and total bandwidth of AAL2 path estimated by CAC during measurement period. The AAL2 path is an ATM VCC between two AAL type 2 entities. The high reservation level may cause blocking of radio bearer setup.

kpi_index.name: AAL2 connection reservation success rate
kpi_index.abbr: AAL2 conn reservation SR
kpi_index.description: The transport resource request success ratio [%]. This KPI describes the average success rate of the transport resource reservation attempts for AAL2 type connections. The low success rate increases the number of unsuccessful RAB setups and requires further troubleshooting in transport layer.

kpi_index.name: HSDPA Resource Accessibility for NRT Traffic
kpi_index.abbr: HSDPA res acc NRT traf
kpi_index.description:
The accessibility of all started resource allocations for HS-DSCH for NRT Traffic. 
The number of times when HS-DSCH channel has been established divided by the number of times when HS-DSCH channel has been selected by cell specific PS.

kpi_index.name: HSDPA MAC-d average net throughput at BTS
kpi_index.abbr: HSDPA MAC-d avg thp BTS
kpi_index.description: HSDPA MAC-d net throughput i.e.successfully delivered MAC-d PDU data to HSDPA Capable UEs assuming that MAC-hs is capable of delivering the PDUs.

kpi_index.name: HSDPA MAC-hs efficiency
kpi_index.abbr: HSDPA MAC-hs efficiency
kpi_index.description: HSDPA Successful transmission ratio i.e. efficiency of HSDPA data transmission between BTS and HSDPA Capable UEs done by MAC-hs. Based on successfully sent MAC-hs PDUs divided by totally sent MAC-hs PDUs. (Total number of all successful sent MAC-hs PDUs divided by total number of all transmitted MAC-hs PDUs (including retransmissions)).

kpi_index.name: HSDPA received data
kpi_index.abbr: HSDPA rcvd Data
kpi_index.description: Amount of data received in NodeB from the RNC in MAC-d PDUs multiplexed into HSDPA channels. This KPI is including original data sent on MAC-ehs PDUs in the primary and secondary cell for Multi-Carrier HSDPA.

kpi_index.name: HSDPA Resource Retainability for NRT Traffic
kpi_index.abbr: HSDPA res retain NRT traf
kpi_index.description: The retainability of all successfully allocated HS-DSCH resources for NRT traffic.

kpi_index.name: HS-DSCH selections
kpi_index.abbr: HS-DSCH selections
kpi_index.description: The number of times when HS-DSCH channel has been selected by cell specific packet scheduler.

kpi_index.name: RAB Success Ratio, NRT Services, from Network Perspective
kpi_index.abbr: RAB SR NRT serv NW
kpi_index.description: RAB Success Ratio for NRT Services [%] over the reporting period. Covers RAB Active Phase of a call.

kpi_index.name: RAB Attempts PS Interactive and Background
kpi_index.abbr: RAB att PS Ia and Bg
kpi_index.description: Number of RAB setup attempts requested for PS Interactive or Background calls. This counter update is depending about profile setting in registry.

kpi_index.name: RAB Attempts Streaming
kpi_index.abbr: RAB att Streaming
kpi_index.description: Number of RAB setup attempts requested for streaming calls.

kpi_index.name: RAB Setup and Access Complete Ratio for Streaming
kpi_index.abbr: RAB stp&acc CR for Stream
kpi_index.description: RAB Setup and Access Complete Ratio for Streaming calls.

kpi_index.name: RAB Success Ratio, Streaming (CSR)
kpi_index.abbr: RAB SR Streaming
kpi_index.description:
RAB Success Ratio for Streaming Services from user perspective over the reporting
period. Covers RAB Active Phase of a call.

kpi_index.name: Average number of simultaneous HSDPA users
kpi_index.abbr: Avg nbr simult HSDPA usr
kpi_index.description: Average number of simultaenous HSDPA users in the target object.

kpi_index.name: DCH Selected due to too many HSDPA users
kpi_index.abbr: DCH slct many HSDPA usr
kpi_index.description:
Congestion due to too many allocated users - ratio of allocation requests that are directed to DCH (due to too many HSDPA users) over all HSDPA allocations.
This KPI is closely related to the indicators illustrating the number of simultaneous HSDPA users. When checking the user distribution in the NW, especially regarding the cells having the largest user numbers, operator need to see whether the high number of users is becoming a bottleneck in the cell.

kpi_index.name: HSDPA Access Failure Rate due to UL DCH
kpi_index.abbr: HSDPA acc FR UL DCH
kpi_index.description: Percentage of HSDPA Access failures due to associated UL DCH channel.

kpi_index.name: HSDPA Access failure rate due to BTS
kpi_index.abbr: HSDPA acc FR due to BTS
kpi_index.description: HSDPA access failure rate due to BTS originated reason

kpi_index.name: Average reported CQI
kpi_index.abbr: Avg reported CQI
kpi_index.description: Average reported CQI.

kpi_index.name: Average MAC-d flow throughput
kpi_index.abbr: Avg MAC-d flow thp
kpi_index.description: The average MAC-d flow throughput calculated as the total HSDPA MAC-d throughput at the BTS divided by the total HSDPA MAC-d allocations. This includes the whole MAC-d allocation time.

kpi_index.name: Active HS-DSCH cell throughput
kpi_index.abbr: Active HS-DSCH cell thr
kpi_index.description:
The average active HS-DSCH MAC-d cell throughput from network perspective calculated as the HSDPA MAC-d throughput at BTS divided by the active HS-DSCH time from the network perspective. 
The active time refers to the scheduled TTIs, i.e. when sending data. 
The throughput is looked at from MAC-d layer, i.e. how much MAC-d level
data the HS-DSCH is able to successfully transfer to UEs using the scheduled
TTIs, so this considers also the MAC-hs efficiency.
When aggregated per BTS and higher this KPIs is still showing average Cell
throughput for all Cells.

kpi_index.name: Cell Availability, excluding blocked by user state (BLU)
kpi_index.abbr: Cell avail excl BLU
kpi_index.description: Cell Availability, excluding blocked by user state (BLU). The KPI gives cell availability defined as the percentage of time the cell(s) is in working state. This KPI shows specifically the availability on times when the cell has not been BLU.

kpi_index.name: Iu Availability
kpi_index.abbr: Iu avail
kpi_index.description: The percentage of time when the Iu interface SCCP subsystem is in working state.

kpi_index.name: Iur Availability
kpi_index.abbr: Iur avail
kpi_index.description: The percentage of time when the Iur interface SCCP subsystem is in working state.

kpi_index.name: Average ratio of utilized CE for DL in BTS
kpi_index.abbr: Avg R utilized CE DL BTS
kpi_index.description: Average ratio of utilized CE for DL in BTS [%].

kpi_index.name: Average ratio of utilized CE for UL in BTS
kpi_index.abbr: Avg R utilized CE UL BTS
kpi_index.description: Average ratio of utilized CE for UL in BTS [%].

kpi_index.name: ATM VCC specific outgoing traffic load
kpi_index.abbr: ATM VCC traf load Iub DL
kpi_index.description:
This KPI shows the outgoing ATM layer traffic load for single ATM VC connection. 
The load is measured in RNC egress direction. 
It depends on the selected configuration, which traffic type utilises one VCC. 
The ATM VCC traffic throughput is compared to the VCC PCR (in the case of CBR connection) or MDCR (in the case of UBR+ connection) to calculate the load [%]. 
If there is dedicated VC connection used for HSDPA, this KPI can be used to follow the HSDPA load over Iub and the same applies to other traffic types as well.

kpi_index.name: HSDPA Serving Cell Change Success Rate
kpi_index.abbr: HSDPA SCC SR
kpi_index.description: HSDPA Serving Cell Change Success Rate over the reporting period in the Source Cell.

kpi_index.name: RAB Success Ratio, NRT Services
kpi_index.abbr: RAB SR NRT Services Usr
kpi_index.description: RAB Success Ratio for NRT Services [%] from user perspective over the reporting period. Covers RAB Active Phase of a call.

kpi_index.name: Minutes per Drop Voice
kpi_index.abbr: Min per Drop Voice
kpi_index.description:
The average minutes per drop for CS Voice. 
This is the user perspective, so the pre-emptions and UE causes are also counted in as failures.

kpi_index.name: Minutes per Drop UDI
kpi_index.abbr: Min per Drop UDI
kpi_index.description:
The average minutes per drop for UDI. 
This is the user perspective, so the pre-emptions and UE causes are also counted in as failures.

kpi_index.name: HSDPA MAC-d data volume at BTS
kpi_index.abbr: HSDPA MAC-d DV at BTS
kpi_index.description: HSDPA MAC-d net throughput i.e.successfully delivered MAC-d PDU data to HSDPA Capable UEs assuming that MAC-hs is capable of delivering the PDUs.

kpi_index.name: CS Voice + PS Multi RAB attempts
kpi_index.abbr: CS Voice + PS M-RAB att
kpi_index.description: The number of RAB setup attemps the result of which would be a multi-RAB combination "CS AMR + PS NRT". Updated when CN requests the Multi-RAB combination to be set up. This is the case when a PS/CS RAB already exists and a CS/PS RAB is set up in addition to it (for the same RRC connection).

kpi_index.name: CS AMR + PS Multi RAB Setup Success Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: CSAMR+PS  MRAB stp SR
kpi_index.description:
Multi RAB (combination "CS AMR + PS NRT) setup success rate. 
Covers RAB Setup and Access phases (From RAB Assignment Request to Radio Bearer Setup Complete).

kpi_index.name: CS AMR + PS Multi RAB Success Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: CS AMR + PS Multi RAB SR
kpi_index.description:
Multi RAB success rate. The KPI describes retainability of multi-RAB
combination "CS AMR + PS NRT"  and covers RAB Active Phase of a call.

kpi_index.name: Intra System Hard Handover Attempts
kpi_index.abbr: Intra System HHO Att
kpi_index.description: Number of Inter RNC Intra Frequency Hard Handover attempts and all Intra RNC/Inter RNC Inter Frequency Hard Handover Attempts.

kpi_index.name: Voice, Minutes
kpi_index.abbr: Voice min
kpi_index.description: Voice minutes. The actual service usage, does not include SHO overhead.

kpi_index.name: UDI, Minutes
kpi_index.abbr: UDI min
kpi_index.description: CS video calls minutes, i.e. UDI minutes. The actual service usage, does not include SHO overhead.

kpi_index.name: Average ATM VCC egress throughput
kpi_index.abbr: Avg ATM VCC egress thp
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the average ATM virtual channel connection (VCC) egress throughput

kpi_index.name: Allocated peak capacity of ATM VCC
kpi_index.abbr: ATM VCC Peak Alloc Rate
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the percentage ratio between peak reserved bandwidth and total bandwidth of AAL2 path estimated by CAC during measurement period.

kpi_index.name: Channel element availability change indication
kpi_index.abbr: CE availability change ind
kpi_index.description:
Indication about changes in the nbr of working or licensed CEs.

The KPI does not provide any exact data about possible problems or upgrades, but it gives an indication that something has changed during the reported interval.

The KPI is based on comparing the number of maximum and minimum nrb of available CEs during the reported period.

kpi_index.name: HSUPA Resource Accessibility for NRT Traffic
kpi_index.abbr: HSUPA res acc NRT traf
kpi_index.description:
The accessibility of all started resource allocations for E-DCH for NRT Traffic. 
The number of times when E-DCH channel has been established divided by the number of times when HS-DSCH channel has been selected by cell specific PS.

kpi_index.name: HSDPA Setup Success Ratio from user perspective
kpi_index.abbr: HSDPA stp SR Usr
kpi_index.description: HSDPA Setup Success Ratio [%] for Streaming, Interactive and Background Services from user perspective over the reporting period.

kpi_index.name: HSUPA Setup Success Ratio from user perspective
kpi_index.abbr: HSUPA stp SR Usr
kpi_index.description: HSUPA Setup Success Ratio [%] for Streaming, Interactive and Background Services from user perspective over the reporting period.

kpi_index.name: Packet Session Setup Success Ratio (SSSR)
kpi_index.abbr: Packet Session stp SR
kpi_index.description: Packet Session Setup Success Ratio over the reporting period.

kpi_index.name: HSUPA MAC-e BLER
kpi_index.abbr: HSUPA MAC-e BLER
kpi_index.description: The measured Block Error Rate for HSUPA Radio Bearers in Uplink. Block Error Rate calculated based on HARQ successful transmissions that didn't require any retransmissions compared to all successful transmissions (regardless of the number of retransmissions) and failed transmissions.

kpi_index.name: HSUPA Serving Cell Change Success Rate
kpi_index.abbr: HSUPA SCC SR
kpi_index.description: HSUPA Serving Cell Success Ratio [%] for the reporting period in the Source Cell of the Hard Handover.

kpi_index.name: HSUPA resource Retainability for NRT Traffic
kpi_index.abbr: HSUPA res retain NRT traf
kpi_index.description: The retainability of all successfully allocated E-DCH resources for NRT traffic.

kpi_index.name: HSDPA Success Ratio from user perspective
kpi_index.abbr: HSDPA SR Usr
kpi_index.description: The HSDPA Success Ratio for Streaming, Interactive and Background Services from user perspective.

kpi_index.name: HSUPA Success Ratio from user perspective
kpi_index.abbr: HSUPA SR Usr
kpi_index.description: The HSUPA Success Ratio for Streaming, Interactive and Background Services from user perspective.

kpi_index.name: Packet Session Success Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: Packet Session SR
kpi_index.description: The Packet Session Success Ratio for Streaming, Interactive and Background Services.

kpi_index.name: E-DCH selections
kpi_index.abbr: E-DCH selections
kpi_index.description: The number of times when E-DCH channel has been selected by cell specific packet scheduler for NRT Traffic.

kpi_index.name: HSDPA attempts
kpi_index.abbr: HSDPA att
kpi_index.description: HSDPA attempts from user perspective over the reporting period.

kpi_index.name: HSDPA Serving Cell Change attempts
kpi_index.abbr: HSDPA SCC att
kpi_index.description: HSDPA Serving Cell Change Attempts over the reporting period in the Source Cell.

kpi_index.name: HSUPA attempts
kpi_index.abbr: HSUPA att
kpi_index.description: HSUPA attempts from user perspective over the reporting period.

kpi_index.name: HSUPA Serving Cell Change attempts
kpi_index.abbr: HSUPA SCC att
kpi_index.description: HSUPA Serving Cell Change Attempts over the reporting period in the Source Cell.

kpi_index.name: Packet Session attempts
kpi_index.abbr: Packet Session att
kpi_index.description: Packet Session Setup Attempts over the reporting period.

kpi_index.name: HSUPA MAC-es data volume at RNC
kpi_index.abbr: HSUPA MAC-es DV at RNC
kpi_index.description: HSUPA MAC-es total throughput based on MAC-es PDUs in RNC.

kpi_index.name: R99 Setup Success Ratio from user perspective
kpi_index.abbr: R99 stp SR Usr
kpi_index.description: R99 Setup Success Ratio for Streaming, Interactive and Background Services [%] from user perspective over the reporting period.

kpi_index.name: R99 Success Ratio from user perspective
kpi_index.abbr: R99 SR Usr
kpi_index.description: The R99 Success Ratio for Streaming, Interactive and Background Services from user perspective.

kpi_index.name: ATM interface based outgoing Data Volume (RNC side)
kpi_index.abbr: ATM If ba out DV RNC side
kpi_index.description:
Total Outgoing data volume for ATM based Traffic in Controlling RNC for the reporting period for a selected logical interface
The outgoing Traffic includes all user plane and control plane traffic between RNC and BTS/neighbour RNC/CN (depends what is the sending NE). 
In the case O&M uses traffic dedicated VPC it can be left out of measurement to increase the number of measured Iub links, see NOTE3.

kpi_index.name: ATM interface based incoming Data Volume (RNC side)
kpi_index.abbr: ATM If ba inc DV RNCside
kpi_index.description:
Total incoming data volume for ATM based Traffic in Controlling RNC for the reporting period for a selected logical interface
The incoming Traffic includes all user plane and control plane traffic between RNC and BTS/neighbour RNC/CN (depends what is the sending NE). 
In the case O&M uses traffic dedicated VPC it can be left out of measurement to increase the number of measured Iub links, see NOTE3.

kpi_index.name: Average ratio of utilized CE for DL for HSUPA in BTS
kpi_index.abbr: Avg R uti CE HSUPA DL BTS
kpi_index.description: Average ratio of utilized CE for HSUPA in DL in BTS [%].

kpi_index.name: Average ratio of utilized CE for UL for HSUPA in BTS
kpi_index.abbr: Avg R uti CE HSUPA UL BTS
kpi_index.description: Average ratio of utilized CE for HSUPA in UL in BTS [%].

kpi_index.name: Spreading Code Blocking rate in DL
kpi_index.abbr: Spreading Code block R DL
kpi_index.description: Spreading Code Blocking rate of a cell over the reporting period.

kpi_index.name: RRC Setup and Access Complete Ratio, from Network Perspective
kpi_index.abbr: RRC stp and acc CR NW
kpi_index.description:
RRC Setup and Access Complete Ratio [%] over the reporting period. Covers RRC Setup and Access phases (From RRC Connection Request to RRC Connection Setup Complete).

To get the "user perspective" RRC connection repetitions and
cell reselections must be excluded as it was done in RNC_154.

kpi_index.name: ATM interface based average throughput for outgoing traffic (RNC side)
kpi_index.abbr: Iub DL avg thp (RNC side)
kpi_index.description:
Average throughput for outgoing ATM based Traffic in Controlling RNC for the reporting period for a selected logical interface
The outgoing Traffic includes all user plane and control plane traffic between RNC and BTS/neighbour RNC/CN (depends what is the sending NE). 
In the case O&M uses traffic dedicated VPC it can be left out of measurement to increase the number of measured Iub links, see NOTE3.

kpi_index.name: ATM interface based average throughput for incoming traffic (RNC side)
kpi_index.abbr: Iub UL avg thp (RNC side)
kpi_index.description:
Average throughput for incoming ATM based Traffic in Controlling RNC for the reporting period for a selected logical interface
The incoming Traffic includes all user plane and control plane traffic between RNC and BTS/neighbour RNC/CN (depends what is the sending NE). 
In the case O&M uses traffic dedicated VPC it can be left out of measurement to increase the number of measured Iub links, see NOTE3.

kpi_index.name: HSUPA MAC-es average throughput at RNC
kpi_index.abbr: HSUPA MAC-es avg thp RNC
kpi_index.description: HSUPA MAC-es average throughput based on MAC-es PDUs in RNC.

kpi_index.name: Maximum Used Channel Elements ratio
kpi_index.abbr: Max Used CE's ratio
kpi_index.description: Maximum used Channel Elements ratio.

kpi_index.name: Average ATM VPC ingress throughput
kpi_index.abbr: Avg ATM VPC ingress thp
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the average ATM virtual path connection (VPC) ingress throughput

kpi_index.name: Average ATM VPC egress throughput
kpi_index.abbr: Avg ATM VPC egress thp
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the average ATM virtual path connection (VPC) egress throughput

kpi_index.name: RRC Setup FR due to AC
kpi_index.abbr: RRC stp FR due to AC
kpi_index.description:
RRC setup failure rate caused by Admission Control.
Note: When the RNC decides to reject the RRC connection request because the admission control entity reports a failure (excluding frozen BTS reason).

kpi_index.name: UL DCH selected due to too many HSUPA usr ratio
kpi_index.abbr: DCH sel many HSUPA usr
kpi_index.description: Percentage of unavailable E-DCH uplink transport channel for interactive, background and strearming class connections due to maximum amount of E-DCH users in the cell exceed the limit defined by MaxNumberEDCHCell or the number of E-DCH users in local cell group exceed MaxNumberEDCHLCG.

kpi_index.name: DL DCH Selected due to the HSDPA power
kpi_index.abbr: DL DCH slct due HSDPA pwr
kpi_index.description: Number of times when HS-DSCH downlink transport channel cannot be selected for interactive, background and streaming class connections due to downlink power limits.

kpi_index.name: SRB Reject Rate UL
kpi_index.abbr: SRB Reject Rate UL
kpi_index.description: Signaling Radio Bearer Reject Rate in Uplink

kpi_index.name: AMR Service Reject Rate UL
kpi_index.abbr: AMR Service rej Rate UL
kpi_index.description: Percentage of RT DCH requests for a CS Voice Call rejected in the SRNC, caused by UL radio resources.

kpi_index.name: CS Data Service Reject Rate UL
kpi_index.abbr: CS Data serv rej Rate UL
kpi_index.description: CS Data Service Reject Rate UL

kpi_index.name: R99 PS Data Service Reject Rate UL
kpi_index.abbr: R99 PS Data serv Rej R UL
kpi_index.description: R99 PS Data Service Reject Rate in uplink direction

kpi_index.name: SCCPCH Average Load
kpi_index.abbr: SCCPCH avg Load
kpi_index.description: Average SCCPCH channel load - including PCH on a measurement period

kpi_index.name: Active HSUPA cell throughput
kpi_index.abbr: Active  HSUPA cell thp
kpi_index.description: HSUPA Cell throughput by comparing the total number of transmitted data against the total amount of active simultaneous HSUPA user's allocation time

kpi_index.name: HSDPA received data per PS RAB drop excluding PCH
kpi_index.abbr: HSDPA rcvd D/drop exc PCH
kpi_index.description: Amount of data received in NodeB from the RNC in MAC-d PDUs plus amount of Multi-Carrier HSDPA original data sent on MAC-ehs PDUs in the primary cell plus amount of Multi-Carrier HSDPA original data sent on MAC-ehs PDUs in the secondary cell per one drop (excluding drops in Cell_PCH state).

kpi_index.name: RNC User Plane Fill Factor
kpi_index.abbr: RNC User Plane Fill Factor
kpi_index.description: The RNC user plane fill factor compares the measured IU PS throughput and AMR Erlangs with the stated RNC capacity. The formula takes into account the measure soft handover at the Iub.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Data Radio Bearer Setup Success Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: Data RB stp SR
kpi_index.description: The KPI shows the setup success ratio for the data radio bearer setup procedure. The RRC connection reconfiguration elementary procedure is used in this context to set up a user-plane (data) radio bearer.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Radio Bearer Drop Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: RB DR
kpi_index.description: The KPI shows the ratio of dropped Radio Bearers.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Initial Context Setup Success Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: S1 init ctxt stp SR
kpi_index.description: The KPI shows the setup success ratio for the "Initial Context Setup" elementary procedure, used to set up an initial UE context in MME (UE-associated logical S1-connection).

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN S1 Setup Success Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: S1 stp SR
kpi_index.description: The KPI shows the setup success ratio for the "S1 Setup" elementary procedure. When this procedure is finished, the S1 interface is operational and other S1 messages can be exchanged.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Setup Success Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN E-RAB stp SR
kpi_index.description:
The KPI indicates the setup success ratio of the elementary E-RAB setup procedure, used to set up the E-RAB between MME and UE.
It shows the E-UTRAN's contribution to network accessibility for the end user, not the whole end-to-end service accessibility.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Normal Release Ratio User Perspective
kpi_index.abbr: E-RAB norm Rel R EPC init
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the ratio of normally released E-RABs from user perspective. This KPI is corresponding to a Connection Completion Ratio.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Normal Release Ratio RAN View
kpi_index.abbr: E-RAB norm RelR ENB init
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the ratio of normally released E-RABs from RAN point of view.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Drop Ratio, RAN View
kpi_index.abbr: E-RAB DR
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the ratio of abnormally released (dropped) E-RABs from RAN point of view.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN RRC Paging Discard Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN RRC Paging Discard Ratio
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the paging request discard ratio on the RRC level.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Success Ratio, intra eNB
kpi_index.abbr: Intra eNB HO SR
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the success ratio for the handover execution phase when the source eNB receives information that the UE is successfully connected to the target cell within its own eNB.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Preparation Success Ratio, intra eNB
kpi_index.abbr: Intra eNB HO prep SR
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the success ratio for the handover preparation phase when the source eNB attempts to prepare resources and finally starts to attempt the handover to a neighboring cell within its own eNB.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Failure Ratio, intra eNB
kpi_index.abbr: intra eNB E-UTRAN HO FR
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the ratio of failed intra-eNB handovers (triggered by THOoverall expiry) to all attempted intra-eNB handovers. This KPI represents the case of a failed handover when all UE resources are still allocated to the UE.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Total HO Success Ratio, intra eNB
kpi_index.abbr: Intra eNB HO SR total
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the total intra-eNB HO success ratio from an HO preparation start until a successful HO execution.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Success Ratio, Inter eNB X2 based
kpi_index.abbr: inter eNB E-UTRAN HO SR X2
kpi_index.description:
This KPI indicates the success ratio for the inter-eNB X2-based handover execution phase when the source eNB
receives information that the UE is successfully connected to
the target cell within the target eNB.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Preparation Success Ratio, inter eNB X2 based
kpi_index.abbr: inter eNB E-UTRAN HO prep SR X2
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the success ratio for the inter eNB X2 based handover preparation phase, when the source eNB attempts to prepare resources and finally starts to attempt the handover to a neighboring cell in a target eNB.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Failure Ratio, inter eNB X2 based
kpi_index.abbr: inter eNB E-UTRAN HO FR X2
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the ratio of failed inter-eNB X2-based handovers (triggered by TX2RELOCoverall expiry) to all attempted inter-eNB handovers. This KPI represents the case of a failed handover when all UE resources are still allocated to the UE.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Total HO Success Ratio, inter eNB X2 based
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN tot HO SR inter eNB X2
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the total inter eNB X2 based HO Success Ratio from HO preparation start until successful HO execution.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Initial E-RAB Accessibility
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN Init E-RAB acc
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the eNB (radio part) observed probability to set up an end to end connection. Under the end to end a connection to be provided with an initial E-RAB at request is meant.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Average incoming Signaling Throughput on X2
kpi_index.abbr: Avg incoming Sign Thp X2
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the average incoming signaling throughput on X2AP layer per eNB.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Average outgoing Signaling Throughput on X2
kpi_index.abbr: Avg outgoing Sign Thp X2
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the average outgoing signaling throughput on X2AP layer per eNB.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Average incoming Data Throughput on X2
kpi_index.abbr: Avg incoming Data Thp X2
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the average incoming user-plane data throughput on X2AP layer per eNB.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN  Average outgoing data Throughput on X2
kpi_index.abbr: Avg outgoing Sign Thp X2
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the average outgoing user-plane data throughput on X2AP layer per eNB.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Preparation Success Ratio, inter eNB S1 based
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN HO Prep SR, inter eNB S1
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the success ratio for the inter eNB S1 based handover preparation phase, when the source eNB attempts to prepare resources and finally starts to attempt the handover to a neighboring cell in a target eNB.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Preparation Failure Ratio per Cause, inter eNB S1 based, due to "timer TS1RELOCprep" failure
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN HO prep FR, timer
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific inter eNB S1based handover preparation failure cause related to total number of inter eNB S1 based HO preparations. The source eNB fails to prepare resources for the handover to a neighboring cell in a target eNB. Cause: "timer TS1RELOCprep" failure (TIME).

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Preparation Failure Ratio per Cause, inter eNB S1 based, due to "lack of resources"
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN HO prep FR, lack rsrc
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific inter eNB S1based handover preparation failure cause related to total number of inter eNB S1 based HO preparations. The source eNB fails to prepare resources for the handover to a neighboring cell in a target eNB. Cause: lack of resources.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Preparation Failure Ratio per Cause, inter eNB S1 based, due to "other" failure
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN HO prep FR, other
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific inter eNB S1based handover preparation failure cause related to total number of inter eNB S1 based HO preparations. The source eNB fails to prepare resources for the handover to a neighboring cell in a target eNB. Cause: "other" failure (OTHER).

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Success Ratio, inter eNB S1 based
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN HO SR, inter eNB S1
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the success ratio for the inter-eNB S1-based handover execution phase when the source eNB receives information that the UE is successfully connected to the target cell within the target eNB.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Failure Ratio, inter eNB S1 based
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN HP FR, inter eNB S1
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the ratio of failed inter-eNB S1-based handovers (triggered by TS1RELOCoverall expiry) to all attempted inter-eNB handovers. This KPI represents the case of a failed handover when all UE resources are still allocated to the UE.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Total HO Success Ratio, inter eNB S1 based
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN tot HO SR, inter eNB S1
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the total inter eNB S1 based HO Success Ratio from HO preparation start until successful HO execution.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Setup Failure Ratio due to radio network layer failure (RNL) cause - Radio Connection with UE lost
kpi_index.abbr: E-RAB SFR RNL
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the ratio of a specific failure cause to all EPS bearer setup attempts. Cause: radio network layer failure (RNL) cause - Radio Connection with UE lost.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Setup Failure Ratio per Cause TRPORT
kpi_index.abbr: E-RAB SFR TRPORT
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the ratio of a specific failure cause to all EPS bearer setup attempts. Cause: transport layer failure (TRPORT)

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Setup Failure Ratio per Cause resource failure (RESOUR)
kpi_index.abbr: E-RAB SFR RESOUR
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific failure cause related to all EPS Bearer set up attempts. Cause: resource failure (RESOUR)

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Setup Failure Ratio per Cause OTH
kpi_index.abbr: E-RAB SFR OTH
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the ratio of a specific failure cause to all EPS bearer setup attempts. Cause: other failure (OTH)

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Drop Ratio per Cause, RNL due to loss of connection to the UE, initiated by eNB
kpi_index.abbr: E-RAB DR, RNL UE loss eNB init
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific E-RAB drop (abnormal release) cause related to all E-RAB releases. Cause: E-RAB drop ratio due to radio network layer (RNL) due to loss of connection to the UE cause initiated by eNB.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Drop Ratio per Cause insufficient transport network layer (TNL) resources, initiated by eNB
kpi_index.abbr: E-RAB DR, TNL insuf rsrc eNB init
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific E-RAB drop (abnormal release) cause related to all E-RAB releases. Cause: E-RAB drop ratio due to insufficient transport network layer  (TNL) resources cause initiated by eNB.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Drop Ratio per Cause Other cause, initiated by eNB
kpi_index.abbr: E-RAB DR, OTH eNB init
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific E-RAB drop (abnormal release) cause related to all E-RAB releases. Casue:  other (OTH) cause initiated by eNB.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN S1 Setup Failure Ratio per Cause No_RESP
kpi_index.abbr: S1 SFR NO_RESP
kpi_index.description:
This KPI indicates the ratio of a specific S1 setup failure
cause to all S1 setup attempts. Cause: "no response" failure (NO_RESP)

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN S1 Setup Failure Ratio per Cause MME
kpi_index.abbr: S1 SFR MME
kpi_index.description:
This KPI indicates the ratio of a specific S1 setup failure
cause to all S1 setup attempts. Cause: "MME" failure (IND_BY_MME)

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Preparation Failure Ratio per Cause, intra eNB AC
kpi_index.abbr: Intra HO prep FR AC
kpi_index.description:
This KPI indicates the ratio of a specific intra-eNB handover
preparation failure cause to the total number of intra-eNB
HO preparations. The source eNB fails to prepare resources
for the handover to a neighboring cell within its own eNB. Cause: "admission control" (AC) failure

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Preparation Failure Ratio per Cause, intra eNB OTH
kpi_index.abbr: Intra HO prep FR OTH
kpi_index.description:
This KPI indicates the ratio of a specific intra-eNB handover
preparation failure cause to the total number of intra-eNB
HO preparations. The source eNB fails to prepare resources
for the handover to a neighboring cell within its own eNB. Cause: "other" (OTH) failure

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Preparation Failure Ratio per Cause, inter eNB X2 based, cause TIME
kpi_index.abbr: Inter X2 based HO prep FR TIME
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific inter eNB X2 based handover preparation failure cause related to total number of inter eNB X2 based HO preparations. The source eNB fails to prepare resources for the handover to a neighboring cell in a target eNB. Cause: "timer" failure (TIME).

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Preparation Failure Ratio per Cause, inter eNB X2 based, cause AC
kpi_index.abbr: Inter X2 based HO prep FR AC
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific inter eNB X2 based handover preparation failure cause related to total number of inter eNB X2 based HO preparations. The source eNB fails to prepare resources for the handover to a neighboring cell in a target eNB. Cause: "admission control" failure (AC).

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Preparation Failure Ratio per Cause, inter eNB X2 based, cause OTHER
kpi_index.abbr: Inter X2 based HO prep FR OTHER
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the ratio of a specific inter eNB X2 based handover preparation failure cause related to total number of inter eNB X2 based HO preparations. The source eNB fails to prepare resources for the handover to a neighboring cell in a target eNB. Cause: "other" failure (OTHER).

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN CS Fallback Attempts with redirection via RRC Connection Release Distribution Rate, connected mode
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN CS Fallback att red, conn mode
kpi_index.description:
This KPI indicates the ratio of specific CS fallback attempts to all CS fallback attempts with redirection via RRC connection release.
percentage CS fallback attempts for a UE in a connected mode.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN CS Fallback Attempts with redirection via RRC Connection Release Distribution Rate, idle mode
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN CS Fallback att red, idle mode
kpi_index.description:
This KPI indicates the ratio of specific CS fallback attempts to all CS fallback attempts with redirection via RRC connection release.
percentage CS fallback attempts for a UE in an idle mode.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN CS Fallback Attempts with redirection via RRC Connection Release Distribution Rate, emergency call
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN CS Fallback att red, emergency call
kpi_index.description:
This KPI indicates the ratio of specific CS fallback attempts to all CS fallback attempts with redirection via RRC connection release.
percentage CS fallback attempts for an emergency call reason.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Initial E-RAB Setup Success Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN Ini E-RAB stp SR
kpi_index.description:
The KPI indicates the setup success ratio for the elementary initial E-RAB setup procedure.
It indicates the E-UTRAN's contribution to network accessibility for the end user, not the whole end-to-end service accessibility.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Additional E-RAB Setup Success Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN Add E-RAB stp SR
kpi_index.description:
The KPI describes the setup success ratio of the elementary additional E-RAB setup procedure.
It indicates the E-UTRAN contribution to network accessibility for the end-user, not the whole end-to-end service accessibility.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Inter-Frequency HO Success Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN Inter-Freq HO SR
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the success ratio for the inter-frequency HO when the source eNB receives information that the UE is successfully connected to the target cell within the target eNB. The KPI is defined independently of network topology (intra-eNB HO/inter-eNB HO) and of the usage of measurement gaps.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Inter-Frequency HO Success Ratio Measurement Gap assisted
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN Inter-Freq HO SR meas gap
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the success ratio for an inter-frequency HO when measurement gaps are configured for the UE when the source eNB receives information that the UE is successfully connected to the target cell within the target eNB. The KPI is defined independently of  network topology (intra-eNB HO/inter-eNB HO).

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Data Radio Bearer Attempts
kpi_index.abbr: DATA RB STP ATT
kpi_index.description: The KPI shows the Data Radio Bearer Setup Attempts.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Radio Bearer Success Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: RB SR
kpi_index.description: The KPI shows the Radio Bearer Success Ratio given as 100 - Radio Bearer Drop Ratio.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Setup Attempt
kpi_index.abbr: E-RAB SAtt
kpi_index.description: The KPI indicates the number of E-RAB setup attempts.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN E-RAB Drop Ratio, User Perspective
kpi_index.abbr: E-RAB DR, User Perspective
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the ratio of abnormally released (dropped) E-RABs from user perspective point of view.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Initial Context Setup Attempts
kpi_index.abbr: S1 init ctxt stp att
kpi_index.description: The KPI shows the number of S1 initial context setup attempts.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN S1 Setup Attempts
kpi_index.abbr: S1 Satt
kpi_index.description: The KPI shows the number of S1 setup attempts.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN RRC Paging Records
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN Paging Records
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the number of RRC paging records.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Preparations, intra eNB
kpi_index.abbr: Intra HO preps
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the total number of intra-eNB HO preparations.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Attempts, intra eNB
kpi_index.abbr: Intra HO Att
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the number of intra-eNB handover attempts.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Attempts, inter eNB X2 based
kpi_index.abbr: Inter X2 based HO Att
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the number of inter-eNB X2-based HO attempts.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Preparation, inter eNB X2 based
kpi_index.abbr: Inter X2 based HO prep
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the number of inter-eNB X2-based HO preparations.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Preparations, inter eNB S1 based
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN HO prep, inter eNB S1
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the number of inter-eNB S1-based HO preparations.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Average Latency Downlink
kpi_index.abbr: Avg Latency DL
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the retention period (delay) of a PDCP SDU (DL) inside an eNB. Time from reception of an IP packet to transmission of a first packet over the Uu interface

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Average Latency Uplink
kpi_index.abbr: Avg Latency Uplink
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the retention period (delay) of a PDCP SDU (UL) inside eNB. Time starting at the successful arrival of the PDCP SDU in the eNB and ending at the first transmission of a packet over S1 containing a segment of the SDU.

kpi_index.name: RRC Connection Re-establishment Attempts, HO fail
kpi_index.abbr: RRC  Re-estab Att, HO
kpi_index.description: The KPI shows the RRC Connection Re-establishment Attempts per type, e.g. total, due to "HandoverFailure", due to "otherFailure" or due to "reconfigFailure". Cause: HandoverFailure.

kpi_index.name: RRC Connection Re-establishment Attempts, other fails
kpi_index.abbr: RRC  Re-estab Att, other
kpi_index.description: The KPI shows the RRC Connection Re-establishment Attempts per type, e.g. total, due to "HandoverFailure", due to "otherFailure" or due to "reconfigFailure". Cause otherFailure

kpi_index.name: Total E-UTRAN RRC Connection Re-establishment Success Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: Total RRC Conn Re-estab SR
kpi_index.description: The KPI shows the setup success ratio for the RRC connection re-establishment procedure. The procedure is used in case of a failure situation (such as a radio or handover failure) to keep the UE in an LTE RRC_CONNECTED state and continue the RRC connection without going to an RRC_IDLE state.

kpi_index.name: Total E-UTRAN RRC Connection Re-establishment rejection Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: Total RRC Conn Re-estab reject Ratio
kpi_index.description: The KPI shows the setup rejection ratio for the RRC connection re-establishment procedure. This happens if a UE is not allowed to do an RRC connection re-establishment for example due to a reconfiguration error during E-RAB release or setup.

kpi_index.name: Total E-UTRAN RRC Connection Re-establishment failure Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: Total RRC Connection Re-estab FR
kpi_index.description: The KPI shows the setup failure ratio for the RRC connection re-establishment procedure. This happens if a UE is allowed to do an RRC connection, but for some reason the procedure is not completed (that is, the RRC connection re-establishment complete message is not received from MS, or RRC connection release complete is sent).

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN S1 Partial Reset Distribution Rate, eNB init
kpi_index.abbr: S1 Partial Reset Distribution Rate, eNB init
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the ratio of specific S1 partial reset messages initiated by the eNB  to all S1 partial reset messages, which allows the eNode B to perform a 'bulk release' of many UE-associated S1-signaling connections available on an S1 link with a one-message exchange between an eNB and MME.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN S1 Partial Reset Distribution Rate, MME init
kpi_index.abbr: S1 Partial Reset Distribution Rate, MME init
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the ratio of specific S1 partial reset messages initiated by the MME to all S1 partial reset messages, which allows the eNode B to perform a 'bulk release' of many UE-associated S1-signaling connections available on an S1 link with a one-message exchange between an eNB and MME.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Preparations for IMS emergecny sessions
kpi_index.abbr: HO Prep, IMS emg sessions
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the total number of HO preparations for IMS emergency sessions.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Preparation Success Ratio for IMS emergency Sessions
kpi_index.abbr: HO Prep SR, IMS emg Sessions
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the success ratio for the handover preparation phase for IMS emergency sessions when the source eNB attempts to prepare resources and finally starts to attempt the handover to a neighboring cell within its own or target eNB.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Attempts for IMS emergency Sessions
kpi_index.abbr: HO Att, IMS emg Sessions
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the number of HO attempts for IMS emergency sessions.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Success Ratio for IMS emergency Sessions,
kpi_index.abbr: HO SR, IMS emg Sessions
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the success ratio for the handover execution phase, when the source eNB receives information that the UE successfully is connected to the target cell within own or target eNB.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Total HO Success Ratio for IMS emergency Sessions
kpi_index.abbr: Total HO SR, IMS emg Sessions
kpi_index.description: This KPI describes the total HO for IMS emergency sessions Success Ratio from HO preparation start until successful HO execution.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Total PDCCH Order Attempts
kpi_index.abbr: Total PDCCH Order Att
kpi_index.description: The KPI indicates the number of PDCCH order attempts. Different indicators distinguish between the total number of PDCCH orders with initial and transmitted retransmissions and only initial orders.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Initial PDCCH Order Attempts
kpi_index.abbr: Initial PDCCH Order Att
kpi_index.description: The KPI indicates the number of PDCCH order attempts. Different indicators distinguish between the total number of PDCCH orders with initial and transmitted retransmissions and only initial orders.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN PDCCH Order Attempts Success Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN PDCCH Order Att SR
kpi_index.description: There are two indicators defined. The first one indicates the ratio of successful PDCCH orders to PDCCH order attempts, except for cases when a dedicated preamble could not be assigned because of a lack of dedicated preamble resources while at the denominator of the second indicator, they are counted. Both indicators provide a PDCCH order attempts success ratio from a UE's point of view; that is, transmitted retransmissions are not counted.

kpi_index.name: Total E-UTRAN PDCCH Order Attempts Success Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: Total PDCCH Order Att SR
kpi_index.description: There are two indicators defined. The first one indicates the ratio of successful PDCCH orders to PDCCH order attempts, except for cases when a dedicated preamble could not be assigned because of a lack of dedicated preamble resources while at the denominator of the second indicator, they are counted. Both indicators provide a PDCCH order attemts success ratio from a  UE's point of view; that is, transmitted retransmissions are not counted.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Unavailability of dedicated preamble, PDCCH order
kpi_index.abbr: Unavail of dedicated preamble, PDCCH order
kpi_index.description: The KPI indicates the number of events when a dedicated preamble could not be assigned (eNB -> UE) because of insufficient dedicated preamble resources in the cell. Different indicators distinguish between the purposes of a dedicated preamble.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Unavailability of dedicated preamble, Handover
kpi_index.abbr: Unavail of dedicated preamble, HO
kpi_index.description: The KPI indicates the number of events when a dedicated preamble could not be assigned (eNB -> UE) because of insufficient dedicated preamble resources in the cell. Different indicators distinguish between the purposes of a dedicated preamble.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Unavailability of dedicated preamble, other
kpi_index.abbr: Unavail of dedicated preamble, other
kpi_index.description: The KPI indicates the number of events when a dedicated preamble could not be assigned (eNB -> UE) because of insufficient dedicated preamble resources in the cell. Different indicators distinguish between the purposes of a dedicated preamble.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Number of Late HO Events
kpi_index.abbr: Number of Late HO Events
kpi_index.description: The KPI indicates the number of late HO events. Where a late handover is a sequence of a missed HO attempt (instead of HO: RLF on a UE side and optionally recoverable RLF on an eNB side) in one cell followed by an RRC connection re-establishment request in another cell.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Number of Type 1 Early HO Events
kpi_index.abbr: Number of Type 1 Early HO Events
kpi_index.description: The KPI indicates the number of Type 1 early HO events, where an early handover Type 1 is a sequence of a failed HO attempt, followed by an RRC connection re-establishment in the HO source cell.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Number of Type 2 Early HO Events
kpi_index.abbr: Number of Type 2 Early HO Events
kpi_index.description: The KPI indicates the number of Type 2 early HO events, where an early handover Type 2 is either a sequence of a successful connection establishment in an HO target cell (attempted HO completed), followed by an RRC connection reestablishment in another cell a short time after 'HO completion' or a sequence of a successful random access in HO target, followed by failed Msg3 reception (attempted HO not completed), followed by a re-establishment request in another cell.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Attempts for UEs running in DRX mode
kpi_index.abbr: HO Attempts for UEs running in DRX mode
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the number of HO attempts for the UEs running in a DRX mode.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN HO Success Ratio for Ues running in DRX mode
kpi_index.abbr: E-UTRAN HO SR, UEs in DRX mode
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the success ratio for the handover execution phase when the source cell receives information that the UE running in a DRX mode is successfully connected to the target cell.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN NACC Attempts from LTE to GSM
kpi_index.abbr: NACC Attempts from LTE to GSM
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the number of NACC attempts from LTE to GSM.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Inter RAT HO Preparations
kpi_index.abbr: Inter RAT HO Preparations
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the total number of inter-RAT HO preparations.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Inter RAT HO Preparation Success Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: Inter RAT HO Preparation SR
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the success ratio for the inter-RAT handover preparation phase when the source attempts to prepare resources and finally starts to attempt the handover to a neighboring cell.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Inter RAT HO Preparation Failure Ratio due to timer
kpi_index.abbr: Inter RAT HO Prep FR, timer
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the ratio of a specific inter-RAT handover preparation failure cause to the total number of inter-RAT HO preparations. The source eNB fails to prepare resources for the handover to a neighboring cell within its own eNB.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Inter RAT HO Preparation Failure Ratio due to Admission control
kpi_index.abbr: Inter RAT HO Prep FR, AC
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the ratio of a specific inter-RAT handover preparation failure cause to the total number of inter-RAT HO preparations. The source eNB fails to prepare resources for the handover to a neighboring cell within its own eNB.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Inter RAT HO Preparation Failure Ratio due to Other
kpi_index.abbr: Inter RAT HO Prep Fratio, Other
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the ratio of a specific inter-RAT handover preparation failure cause to the total number of inter-RAT HO preparations. The source eNB fails to prepare resources for the handover to a neighboring cell within its own eNB.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Inter RAT PS-HO to WCDMA Success Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: Inter RAT PS HO WCDMA SR
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the success ratio for the inter-RAT handover execution phase when the source eNB receives information that the UE is successfully connected to the target cell (WCDMA).

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Inter RAT PS-HO to WCDMA Attempts
kpi_index.abbr: Inter RAT PS HO WCDMA Att
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the number of inter-RAT handover attempts.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Inter RAT PS-HO to WCDMA Failure Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: Inter RAT PS HO WCDMA FR
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the ratio of failed inter-RAT PS-HOs triggered by TS1RELOCoverall expiry to all attempted inter-RAT PS-HOs to WCDMA. This KPI represents the case of a failed handover when all UE resources are still allocated to the UE.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Inter RAT Total HO Success Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: Inter RAT Total HO SR
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the total inter-RAT HO success ratio from an HO preparation start until a successful HO execution.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Additional E-RAB Setup Attempts for IMS Emergency Sessions
kpi_index.abbr: Add E-RAB Stp Att, IMS Emg
kpi_index.description: This KPI indicates the number of additional E-RAB setup attempts for IMS emergency sessions.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Additional E-RAB Setup Success Ratio for IMS Emergency Sessions
kpi_index.abbr: Add E-RAB Stp SR, IMS Emg
kpi_index.description: The KPI describes the setup success ratio of the elementary additional E-RAB setup procedure for IMS emergency sessions.It indicates the E-UTRAN contribution to network accessibility for the end-user, not the whole end-to-end service accessibility.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Additional E-RAB Setup Failures for IMS Emergency Sessions
kpi_index.abbr: Add E-RAB Stp Fails, IMS Emg

The KPI is defined independent of the network topology (intra eNB HO / inter eNB HO) and of the usage of measurement gaps.

kpi_index.name: Inter RAT HO preparation FR #2 to 1xRTT with SRVCC

CE level 0 is perceived as a good radio condition option.

kpi_index.name: E-UTRAN Inter-Frequency SPID based HO Success Ratio

RLF_INITIATED_UE_RACH_FAIL and RLF_INITIATED_UE_SCG_CHGE_FAIL are excluded as they happen before RACH success.

kpi_index.name: 5G NSA SgNB triggered abnormal release ratio excluding X2 reset

This KPI indicates SgNB initiated abnormal Release Ratio for SCG split bearers, excluding the relases caused by X2 reset. MeNB initiated releases are considered as normal releases.
RLF_INITIATED_UE_RACH_FAIL and RLF_INITIATED_UE_SCG_CHGE_FAIL are excluded as they happen before RACH success.

kpi_index.name: 5G NSA Ratio of SgNB releases initiated by SgNB due to UE inactivity

The denominator represents the total number of releases. RLF_INITIATED_UE_RACH_FAIL and RLF_INITIATED_UE_SCG_CHGE_FAIL are excluded from denominator as they happen before RACH success.

kpi_index.name: 5G Average estimated F1 round trip delay between CU and MAC DU
kpi_index.abbr: Avg F1 rnd trip delay CU MAC DU
kpi_index.description:
This KPI shows the average estimated F1 round trip delay between CU and MAC DU, measured on gNB and per DU. It is the time:
- Starting when the PDCP PDU packet is sent by CU over F1 (PDCP PDU packet has left CU)
Then, this PDCP PDU packet is going until MAC PDU (of DU). When the 1st segment is ready to be sent  on the air for the first time (excluding repetitions), the MAC PDU sends a DDDS to CU.      
- And ending when the DDDS (sent by the MAC PDU) message is received by CU over F1 to acknowledge the packet (removed from CU buffer).
Note: 
-	We can consider that the time to process the DDDS message is equivalent to a PDU message received on CU over F1 and the PDU was sent by MAC PDU.

kpi_index.name: 5G NSA Average estimated X2 round trip delay between CU and MAC eNB
kpi_index.abbr: NSA Avg X2 rnd trip delay CU MAC eNB
kpi_index.description:
This KPI shows the average estimated X2 round trip delay between CU and MAC eNB cell, measured on gNB and per X2. It is the time:
       - starting when the PDCP PDU packet is sent by CU over X2 until RLC multiplexed packet in the MAC PDU (of cell of eNB) to be transmitted in the air for the first time
       - and ending when the DDDS (sent by the MAC PDU) message is received by CU over X2 to acknowledge the packet (removed from CU buffer).
Note: We can consider that the time to process the DDDS message is equivalent to a PDU message received on CU over X2 and the PDU was sent by MAC PDU (of cell of eNB).

kpi_index.name: 5G Initial BLER in downlink transmissions in PDSCH
kpi_index.abbr: Init BLER DL PDSCH tx
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the Initial Block Error Ratio calculated as the failure ratio for the first HARQ transmission for PDSCH. It considers transmissions with 64QAM MCS and 256QAM MCS. HARQ feedback DTX is considered as unsuccessful.

kpi_index.name: 5G Residual Block Error Ratio (BLER) for PDSCH
kpi_index.abbr: Resid BLER DL
kpi_index.description:
This KPI shows the residual Block Error Ratio (BLER) for PDSCH. Residual BLER is defined as the ratio between the number of failed transmissions after the MAX harq retransmission reached and the number of packets to transmit, that is, the 1st HARQ transmissions.
In real-time monitoring, the HARQ feedback might be received in a diferent measurement period than the initial transmission. For that reason, the initial transmissions in the formula are calculated as the successful transmissions plus the unsuccessful transmissions.
HARQ feedback DTX is considered as unsuccessful.

kpi_index.name: 5G Initial BLER in PUSCH
kpi_index.abbr: UL init BLER PUSCH
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the failure ratio for the first HARQ transmission for PUSCH.

kpi_index.name: 5G Residual BLER in PUSCH
kpi_index.abbr: UL resid BLER PUSCH
kpi_index.description:
This KPI shows the residual Block Error Ratio (BLER) for PUSCH. Residual BLER is defined as the ratio between the number of failed transmissions after the MAX harq retransmission reached and the number of packets to transmit, that is, the 1st HARQ transmissions.
In real-time monitoring, the HARQ feedback might be received in a diferent measurement period than the initial transmission. For that reason, the initial transmissions in the formula are calculated as the successful transmissions plus the unsuccessful transmissions.

kpi_index.name: 5G NSA Inter gNB PSCell change preparation attempt on target gNB
kpi_index.abbr: NSA IntergNB PSC chng prep att tgNB
kpi_index.description:
This KPI shows the inter gNB PSCell change preparation attempts measured in the target gNB. The preparation attempts are the number of X2AP: SGNB ADDITION REQUEST messages received from LTE eNB upon SN Change trigger.
Intra frequency and inter frequency PSCell changes are taken into account.

kpi_index.name: 5G NSA Inter gNB PSCell change preparation success ratio on target gNB
kpi_index.abbr: NSA IntergNB PSC chng prep SR tgNB
kpi_index.description:
This KPI shows the inter gNB PSCell change preparation sussess ratio measured in the target gNB. The preparation attempts are the number of X2AP: SGNB ADDITION REQUEST messages received from LTE eNB upon SN Change trigger. The successful preparations are given by the number of X2AP: SGNB ADDITION ACKNOWLEDGE sent by target gNB to LTE eNB, upon SN Change trigger.
Intra frequency and inter frequency PSCell changes are taken into account.

kpi_index.name: 5G NSA Inter gNB PSCell change execution attempts on target gNB
kpi_index.abbr: NSA IntergNB PSC chng exec att tgNB
kpi_index.description:
This KPI shows the inter gNB PSCell change execution attempts calculated on the target gNB. The execution attempts are consideral equal to the preparation successes, given by the number of X2AP: SGNB ADDITION ACKNOWLEDGE sent by target gNB to LTE eNB, upon SN Change trigger.
Intra frequency and inter frequency PSCell changes are taken into account.

kpi_index.name: 5G NSA Inter gNB PSCell change execution success ratio on target gNB
kpi_index.abbr: NSA IntergNB PSC chng exec SR tgNB
kpi_index.description:
This KPI shows the inter gNB PSCell change execution success ratio calculated on the target gNB. The execution is considered successful when target gNB receives the X2AP: SGNB RECONFIGURATION COMPLETE sent by LTE eNB (with Configuration successfully applied IE) upon SN Change trigger. The execution attempts are given by the number of  X2AP: SGNB ADDITION REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE sent to LTE eNB, upon SN Change trigger.
Intra frequency and inter frequency PSCell changes are taken into account.

kpi_index.name: 5G NSA Inter gNB PSCell change total success ratio on target gNB
kpi_index.abbr: NSA IntergNB PSC chng tot SR tgNB
kpi_index.description:
This KPI shows the inter gNB PSCell change total success ratio calculated in the target gNB. The total success ratio is calculated from the successful execution over the preparation attempts. The preparation attempts are the number of X2AP: SGNB ADDITION REQUEST messages received from LTE eNB upon SN Change trigger. The execution successes are given by the number of X2AP: SGNB RECONFIGURATION COMPLETE messages (with Configuration successfully applied IE) sent by LTE eNB to the target gNB, upon SN Change trigger.
Intra frequency and inter frequency PSCell changes are taken into account.

kpi_index.name: 5G MAC PDU  Cell throughput on active PDSCH data slots on initial HARQ transmissions
kpi_index.abbr: MAC Cell thp act PDSCH data slots
kpi_index.description:
This KPI shows the cell throughput on active PDSCH calculated at MAC layer by dividing the MAC PDU data volume transmitted on initial HARQ tx divided by the accumulated time of data slots used for PDSCH.
This KPI gives info about RF capability as slots available for PDSCH (like UL Data slots or PRACH slots) are not considered in denominator. The SSB slots and TRS slots used for PDSCH are considered in denominator.

This KPI gives info about RF capability as slots not available for PUSCH (like DL Data slots, SSB slots or PRACH slots) are not considered in denominator.

kpi_index.abbr: Act cell MAC thp PDSCH
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the active cell throughput on PDSCH calculated at MAC layer by dividing the MAC PDU data volume transmitted on initial HARQ tx divided by the accumulated time of OFDM symbols used for PDSCH.

kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the active cell throughput on PUSCH calculated at MAC layer by dividing the MAC PDU data volume transmitted on initial HARQ tx divided by the accumulated time of OFDM symbols used for PUSCH.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA PDCP SDU throughput in downlink
kpi_index.abbr: SA PDCP SDU thp DL
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the SA PDCP SDU throughput in downlink direction, calculated in the measurement period.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA PDCP SDU throughput in uplink
kpi_index.abbr: SA PDCP SDU thp UL
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the SA PDCP SDU throughput in uplink direction, calculated in the measurement period.

kpi_index.name: 5G Scheduled user throughput in downlink
kpi_index.abbr: Sched user thp DL
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the scheduled user throughput in downlink calculated as the cell throughput divided by the total accumulated UEs scheduling time in DL.

kpi_index.name: 5G Average UE related SINR for PUSCH
kpi_index.abbr: Avg UE rel SINR PUSCH
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the average UE related Signal to Interference and Noise Ratio (SINR) for PUSCH (using Rank 1 or Rank2) measured in the gNB, calculated from the bin counters.

kpi_index.name: 5G Average MAC layer user throughput in downlink
kpi_index.abbr: Avg MAC user thp DL exc DRX sleep
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the average MAC layer user throughput in downlink. Calculated as MAC SDU volume with the accumulated UEs time with data in the buffer for DRBs excluding DRX sleep state.

kpi_index.name: 5G Average MAC layer user throughput in uplink
kpi_index.abbr: Avg MAC user thp UL
kpi_index.description:
This KPI shows the average MAC layer user throughput in uplink. It is calculated as Cell throughput divided by number of users.
NR_5101b is only valid if ACC_UE_UL_DRB_DATA sample period is 1 slot.
Cell user throughput = Volume in Mbits / (Accumulated number of users with buffered data (sampled every 1 slots) * 1 slots * Slot duration)

kpi_index.name: 5G SA SCell Change Success Ratio
kpi_index.abbr: SA Scell chg SR
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the SA SCell Change Success Ratio, counted in the PCell.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA SCell Change Attempts
kpi_index.abbr: SA Scell chg att
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the SA SCell Change Attempts, counted in the PCell.

kpi_index.name: 5G NSA Ratio of duplicated PDCP data PDUs sent over X2-U in downlink
kpi_index.abbr: 5G NSA Dupl DL PDCP PDUs X2-U R
kpi_index.description:
This KPI shows the percentage of DL PDCP data PDUs sent over X2-U due to duplication, compared to total number of DL PDCP data PDUs sent over X2-U.
PDU duplication is a mechanism for resetting inactivity timer for MeNB leg for NSA 3X mode to keep it alive even when LTE leg is out of data.

kpi_index.name: 5G Average MCS used in uplink for PUSCH with 256QAM table
kpi_index.abbr: Avg UL MCS 256QAM
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the average MCS used for uplink data transmissions over PUSCH with 256QAM MCS table.

kpi_index.name: 5G Spectral efficiency in downlink
kpi_index.abbr: Spectr effic DL
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the Spectral efficiency calculated from the initial transmission or retransmission on PDSCH and the PDSCH OFDM symbols time.

kpi_index.name: 5G Spectral efficiency in uplink
kpi_index.abbr: Spectr effic UL
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the Spectral efficiency calculated from the initial transmission or retransmission on PUSCH and the PUSCH OFDM symbols time.

kpi_index.name: 5G Usage ratio of PDSCH data slots over all DL data slots
kpi_index.abbr: PDSCH sl per all DL dat sl R
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the ratio of PDSCH data slots with at least one user scheduled over all DL data slots.

kpi_index.name: 5G Usage ratio of PUSCH data slots over all UL data slots
kpi_index.abbr: PUSCH sl per all UL dat sl R
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the ratio of PUSCH data slots with at least one user scheduled over all UL data slots.

kpi_index.name: 5G PRB utilization for PDSCH
kpi_index.abbr: PRB util PDSCH
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the utilization of PRBs for PDSCH.

kpi_index.name: 5G PRB utilization for PUSCH
kpi_index.abbr: PRB util PUSCH
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the utilization of PRBs for PUSCH.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA DU Radio admission success ratio for SA users
kpi_index.abbr: SA DU RA SR
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the ratio of admitted radio admission requests for SA user in DU.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA Non-GBR DRB radio admission success ratio for SA users in DU
kpi_index.abbr: SA DU NGBR DRB RA SR
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the ratio of non-GBR DRB successful radio admissions for SA user in DU.

kpi_index.name: 5G Percentage of Power Headroom Reports of UEs with Available Uplink Power
kpi_index.abbr: % of UEs with available Uplink Pwr
kpi_index.description: This KPI provides the percentage of Power Headroom reports of UEs with enough UL power resources to transmit on PUSCH, (when UE reports a positive Power Headroom).

kpi_index.name: 5G SA Maximum number of SA users with non-GBR DRBs
kpi_index.abbr: SA Max nonGBR DRB users
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the maximum number of SA users having one or more non-GBR DRBs.

kpi_index.name: 5G Average number of active UEs with data in the buffer for DRBs in DL
kpi_index.abbr: Avg nr act UEs data buff DRBs DL
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the average number of PSCell or Scell UEs which have buffered data in any DRB in downlink direction.

kpi_index.name: 5G Average number of active UEs with data in the buffer for DRBs in UL
kpi_index.abbr: Avg nr act UEs data buff DRBs UL
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the average number of PSCell or Scell UEs which have buffered data in any DRB in uplink direction.

kpi_index.name: 5G Maximum number of active UEs with data in the buffer for DRBs in DL
kpi_index.abbr: Max nr UEs data in buff DRBs DL
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the maximum number of PSCell or Scell UEs having data in buffers for DRBs in downlink direction during the measurement period .

kpi_index.name: 5G Maximum number of active UEs with data in the buffer for DRBs in UL
kpi_index.abbr: Max nr UEs data in buff DRBs UL
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the maximum number of PSCell or Scell UEs having data in buffers for DRBs in uplink direction during the measurement period .

kpi_index.name: 5G NSA Average number of NSA users in selected area
kpi_index.abbr: NSA Avg nr user
kpi_index.description:
This KPI shows the average number of NSA users, that is the number of users with at least one 5G DRB.
KPI values are aggregated (sum) over the object dimension. Meaning that, if KPI is calculated over PLMN object, it shows the average number of users in all PLMN.

kpi_index.name: 5G NSA Maximum number of NSA users per cell
kpi_index.abbr: NSA Max nr user
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the maximum number of NSA users per cell, that is, the number of users with at least one 5G DRB.

kpi_index.name: 5G NSA Average admission holding time of NSA users
kpi_index.abbr: NSA Avg hold t user
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the average admission holding time of NSA users, counting from successful AC and stops in AC release for the UE in the DU.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA Average number of SA non-GBR users in selected area
kpi_index.abbr: SA Avg nr nonGBR UEs
kpi_index.description:
This KPI shows the average number of non-GBR users having one or more DRBs in stand alone operation.
KPI values are aggregated (sum) over the object dimension. Meaning that, if KPI is calculated over PLMN object, it shows the average number of users in all PLMN.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA Average number of SA RRC connected users in selected area
kpi_index.abbr: SA Avg nr nonGBR RRC conn UEs
kpi_index.description:
This KPI shows the average number of RRC connected users in stand alone operation.
KPI values are aggregated (sum) over the object dimension. Meaning that, if KPI is calculated over PLMN object, it shows the average number of users in all PLMN.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA Maximum number of SA RRC connected users
kpi_index.abbr: SA Max RRC users
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the maximum number of SA RRC connected users.

kpi_index.name: 5G NSA Downlink carrier aggregation reconfiguration success ratio
kpi_index.abbr: NSA DL CA reconf SR
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the SgNB initiated RRC Reconfiguration success ratio for carrier aggregation in downlink.

kpi_index.name: 5G NSA Downlink carrier aggregation reconfiguration attempts
kpi_index.abbr: NSA DL CA reconf att
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the SgNB initiated RRC Reconfiguration attempts for carrier aggregation in downlink.

kpi_index.name: 5G NSA Uplink carrier aggregation reconfiguration success ratio
kpi_index.abbr: NSA UL CA reconf SR
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the SgNB initiated RRC Reconfiguration success ratio for carrier aggregation in uplink.

kpi_index.name: 5G NSA Uplink carrier aggregation reconfiguration attempts
kpi_index.abbr: NSA UL CA reconf att
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the SgNB initiated RRC Reconfiguration attempts for carrier aggregation in uplink.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA PDCP SDU transmitted data volume in downlink per slice
kpi_index.abbr: PDCP SDU vol DL slice
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the PDCP SDU data volume transmitted via gNB in downlink direction for the given Slice and PLMN. Discarded DL PDCP SDUs are not counted.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA PDCP SDU received data volume in uplink per slice
kpi_index.abbr: PDCP SDU vol UL slice
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the PDCP SDU data volume received at gNB in uplink direction for the given Slice and PLMN. Discarded UL PDCP SDUs are not counted.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA PDCP SDU average delay in downlink per slice
kpi_index.abbr: PDCP SDU avg delay DL slice
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the downlink average delay for PDCP SDUs per slice, calculated as time difference between the reception of the PDCP SDU from NG-U and DL PDCP PDU is sent towards RLC layer.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA PDCP SDU average delay in uplink per slice
kpi_index.abbr: PDCP SDU avg delay UL slice
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the uplink average delay for PDCP SDUs per slice, calculated as time difference between reception of UL PDCP PDU from RLC layer, and when the PDCP SDU is sent towards NG-U.

kpi_index.name: 5G NSA F1 data split ratio in downlink
kpi_index.abbr: NSA F1 data split R DL
kpi_index.description:
This KPI shows the percentage of data volume sent over F1-U in downlink, compared with the total data volume transmitted via gNB or eNB in downlink.
The formula gives an indication of the ammount of traffic going through 5G gNB.

kpi_index.name: 5G NSA F1 data split ratio in uplink
kpi_index.abbr: NSA F1 data split R UL
kpi_index.description:
This KPI shows the percentage of data volume received over F1-U in uplink, compared with the total data volume received  via gNB or eNB in uplink.
The formula gives an indication of the ammount of traffic going through 5G gNB.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA Number of PDU session resource setup requests
kpi_index.abbr: SA PDU sess rsrc stp req
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the number of NGAP: PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP REQUEST messages received at gNB-CU.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA PDU session resource setup success ratio
kpi_index.abbr: PDU sess rsrc stp SR
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the success ratio of the PDU session resource setup. The procedure is successful when the gNB-CU responds to 5GC with PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP RESPONSE message.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA Number of AMF selection attempted by gNB
kpi_index.abbr: AMF sel att gNB
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the number of AMF selections failed by gNB for UE coming from idle.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA AMF selection by gNB success ratio
kpi_index.abbr: AMF sel SR gNB
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the success ratio of AMF selections by gNB for UE coming from idle.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA Number of AMF reselection attempted by gNB
kpi_index.abbr: AMF resel att gNB
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the number of AMF reselections attempted by gNB for connected UE.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA AMF reselection by gNB success ratio
kpi_index.abbr: AMF resel SR gNB
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the success ratio of AMF reselections by gNBconnected UE.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA Normal gNB-initiated release (due to Inactivity) ratio
kpi_index.abbr: SA Norm gNB init rel R

kpi_index.name: 5G SA Normal gNB-initiated release ratio - RAN view

kpi_index.name: 5G Average PDCCH CCE starvation ratio in cell
kpi_index.abbr: Avg PDCCH CCE starv R
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the average ratio of slots with DL and UL grant capability and CCE starvation involving a UE scheduling rejection whereas PDSCH or PUSCH resources are available in the cell. Value is calculated based on starvation ratio in the cell BWP 0-9.

kpi_index.name: 5G Cell availability ratio
kpi_index.abbr: Cell avail R
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the ratio of time in which services in a cell are available for end users.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA Accessibility success ratio
kpi_index.abbr: SA access SR
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the percentage of success when a user tries to establish a connection in 5G SA mode.

kpi_index.name: 5G Cell availability ratio excluding planned unavailability periods
kpi_index.abbr: Cell avail exclud BLU
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the ratio of time in which services in a cell are available for end users, excluding the periods that the cell unavailability is planned.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA 5QI1 QoS flow drop ratio per cell
kpi_index.abbr: SA 5QI1 QoS flow DR cell
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the ratio of the number of abnormally released 5QI1 QoS flows initiated by gNB and AMF to total number of 5QI1 QoS flow release attempts (gNB and AMF initiated), including the releases due to intra-NR successful handover.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA QoS flow drop ratio per cell
kpi_index.abbr: SA QoS flow DR cell
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the ratio of the number of abnormally released QoS flows initiated by gNB and AMF to total number of QoS flow releases (gNB and AMF initiated), including the releases due to intra-NR successful handover.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA PDU session setup success ratio for IMS Emergency calls
kpi_index.abbr: SA PDU sess stp SR Emg
kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the ratio of successful PDU session setup procedures for VoNR Emergency Call.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA initial context setup success ratio for IMS Emergency calls
kpi_index.abbr: SA init ctx stp SR Emg

kpi_index.name: 5G SA Total number of RRC connection establishment attempts

kpi_index.description: This KPI shows the total number of RRC connection establishment attempts, calculated as the sum of all different establishment causes.

kpi_index.name: 5G SA Number of radio admission requests for SA users
